lessons.titleEn: do not run on good intentions alone

target.pattern: \b(?:do|does) not run on good intentions alone\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Community clinics do not run on good intentions alone.
sources.expression: do not run on good intentions alone

brief.meaningEn: Need practical resources and arrangements, not only a desire to help.
brief.meaningZh: 除了想幫忙的善意，還需要實際資源及安排才能運作。
brief.grammar: projects do not run on good intentions alone; a project does not run on good intentions alone; run means operate
brief.boundaryZh: 肯定善意的可能價值，同時指出不足之處；不是說有資源就不需關懷，也不是汽油或機器的字面用法。
brief.misconceptionZh: 肯定善意的可能價值，同時指出不足之處；不是說有資源就不需關懷，也不是汽油或機器的字面用法。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「不能只靠善意來運作」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: An extended operation metaphor in a transparent sentence, not a fixed proverb. Original clinic example is provenance; practice names nonmedical resources.

listening.en: Our weekend reading club does not run on good intentions alone: someone must unlock the room, prepare the books and agree who will welcome the children.
listening.zh: 周末讀書社不能只靠善意運作：需有人開門、備書，並議定誰接待孩子。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 讀書社除了善意，也需要清楚的實際安排。
書本及房間已備好，說話者只在問大家是否想參與。
開門及接待都已安排好，缺的只是更多書。
說話者主要在比較這次活動與上次活動的受歡迎程度。

listening.explanationZh: unlock、prepare、agree who 是運作條件；未說安排已妥或比較人氣。

reply.promptEn: Why are you asking who will open the room and welcome the children?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼問誰開門及接待孩子？

options.en: The club does not run on good intentions alone; those practical jobs need someone responsible for them.
options.zh: 讀書社不能只靠善意運作；那些實際工作需有人負責。

options.en: We need clear responsibilities as well as people who want to help.
options.zh: 除了想幫忙的人，也需清楚責任分配。

options.en: The children need a room that is open and someone ready to receive them.
options.zh: 孩子需要已開放的房間及準備好接待的人。

options.en: An offer to help becomes useful when we agree the actual arrangements.
options.zh: 議定實際安排時，幫忙提議才能發揮作用。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 你們想製作社區刊物，大家很熱心，但印製時間、可用檔案及校對責任尚未確認。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The magazine does not run on good intentions alone; the production arrangements still need agreeing.
options.zh: 刊物不能只靠善意運作；製作安排仍需議定。

options.en: A list of willing volunteers is enough to serve as the production rota before print and proofreading duties are agreed.
options.zh: 未議定印製及校對責任，有願意幫忙者的清單便足以當製作輪值表。

options.en: The main issue is a lack of interest, rather than unfinished practical arrangements.
options.zh: 主要問題是沒興趣，而非實際安排未完成。

scene.explanationZh: 熱心名單仍需轉成已議定的製作責任；題目有興趣，缺的是實際安排，不是沒人想參與。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解最符合 do not run on good intentions alone？

options.en: 善意可以重要，但仍需實際資源與安排。
只要有設備，便不需在意參與者的需要。
運作是否準備好，只需問大家想不想幫忙。

contrast.explanationZh: alone 否定只靠善意，不是否定善意，也不把資源當唯一考量。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「大家都說願意幫，先邀孩子來，之後才定誰開門吧？」哪句回應最合適？

options.en: Let us agree who opens and welcomes first; the club does not run on good intentions alone.
options.zh: 先議定誰開門及接待吧；讀書社不能只靠善意運作。

options.en: Use the list of interested volunteers as the confirmed opening rota.
options.zh: 把有興趣的義工清單當已確認開門輪值表。

options.en: Choose the invitation design now and leave the room arrangements until the children arrive.
options.zh: 現在選邀請設計，孩子到時才處理房間安排。

dialogue.explanationZh: 確認實際責任後再邀請，不把意願名單當已答應的輪值。

speaking.en: Community projects do not run on good intentions alone; clear responsibilities turn support into something usable.
speaking.zh: 社區計劃不能只靠善意運作；清楚責任分配，才能把支持轉成用得上的幫助。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把善意與運作條件分開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你要感謝一位鄰居借出貨車並親自運送捐書，讓原本只有熱心呼籲的收集計劃真正能把書送到。用一至兩句英文寫謝卡，具體說明他的實際貢獻，不只泛說他很好人。

examples.en: Book collections do not run on good intentions alone, and your van and time made the delivery possible. Thank you for turning our appeal into practical help.
examples.zh: 捐書收集不能只靠善意運作；你的貨車及時間讓運送成為可能。謝謝你把我們的呼籲轉成實際幫助。

examples.en: Our collection does not run on good intentions alone; transporting the books was the part we could not manage. We are grateful that you took care of it yourself.
examples.zh: 我們的收集計劃不能只靠善意運作；運書是我們無法處理的部分。感謝你親自照料這件事。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以貨車及運送時間說明實際貢獻，讓謝意有具體依據，不把善意與資源互相排斥。

takeaways.en: The workshop does not run on good intentions alone; volunteers need materials and a workable schedule.
takeaways.zh: 工作坊不能只靠善意運作；義工需要材料及可行時間表。

takeaways.en: These small services do not run on good intentions alone, so we agreed who would handle each weekly task.
takeaways.zh: 這些小型服務不能只靠善意運作，所以我們議定誰處理每周各項工作。

sources.sentence: Hospitals can come under enormous strain in winter.

brief.meaningEn: Begin to face very heavy pressure on capacity, resources or ability to cope.
brief.meaningZh: 開始在容量、資源或應付能力方面承受極大壓力。
brief.grammar: a service/team comes under enormous strain; came in past; under strain is a pressure collocation
brief.boundaryZh: 程度很強，需具體容量線索；承壓不等於已完全停運，也不能只憑有點忙便使用 enormous。
brief.misconceptionZh: 程度很強，需具體容量線索；承壓不等於已完全停運，也不能只憑有點忙便使用 enormous。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「承受極大壓力」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The small enquiries team came under enormous strain when applications doubled and two staff were away; replies took much longer, though the desk stayed open.
listening.zh: 申請倍增、兩名職員不在，小型查詢團隊承受極大壓力；回覆慢了很多，但櫃檯仍開放。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 工作量與人手變化使團隊應付能力承受很大壓力。
櫃檯已關閉，不再接受任何查詢。
回覆變慢主要因團隊決定每封都加長內容。
人手及申請量都與之前相同，只是換了櫃檯位置。

listening.explanationZh: applications doubled、staff away 及 replies longer 支持強烈承壓，而 still open保留運作。

reply.promptEn: Why were replies taking so much longer?
reply.promptZh: 回覆為甚麼慢了很多？

options.en: The team came under enormous strain as applications doubled while two staff were away.
options.zh: 申請倍增而兩名職員不在，團隊承受極大壓力。

options.en: There was much more work and less staff time to handle it.
options.zh: 工作多了很多，可處理的人手時間卻少了。

options.en: The available team had to respond to a sharply larger number of applications.
options.zh: 現有團隊需回應大幅增加的申請。

options.en: Demand grew at the same time as the team temporarily lost two members.
options.zh: 需求增加的同時，團隊暫時少了兩位成員。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 小型場館一周臨時接了三場額外活動，原本兩位技術員還要處理維修，排期及回覆大幅延遲，但仍提供服務。哪句貼切？

options.en: The venue team has come under enormous strain.
options.zh: 場館團隊已承受極大壓力。

options.en: The delays affect repairs alone; replies about the new events are continuing at their usual pace.
options.zh: 延遲只影響維修；新活動回覆仍按平常速度進行。

options.en: The team has cancelled the new events and reserved all its time for repairs.
options.zh: 團隊已取消新活動，把全部時間留給維修。

scene.explanationZh: 額外活動及維修使排期與回覆都大幅延遲，支持極大壓力；不是只影響維修，也未取消新活動。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 come under enormous strain？

options.en: 工作量激增，人手不足，回覆大幅延後。
只是比平常多一個小查詢，團隊仍很輕鬆。
多項緊急需要超出目前短期可應付的安排。

contrast.explanationZh: enormous 是強程度，不應只用於輕微而易處理的增加。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「他們還開門，就不算有壓力吧？」但查詢已倍增，人手減少，回覆很慢。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: A team can come under enormous strain while still operating; the workload and delays show the pressure here.
options.zh: 團隊仍運作，也可承受極大壓力；這裏工作量及延誤顯示負擔。

options.en: Use the open-door sign as evidence that the present staffing is comfortable.
options.zh: 把開門告示當現有人手充裕的證據。

options.en: The phrase should be saved until the desk has stopped all activity.
options.zh: 應等櫃檯停止全部活動後才用這片語。

dialogue.explanationZh: 仍提供服務與能力承壓可並存，不以開門與否一項判斷。

speaking.en: The team came under enormous strain, but it continued responding while the organisers reviewed the workload.
speaking.zh: 團隊承受極大壓力，但主辦者檢視工作量時，仍繼續回應。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再保留強程度與仍運作的區別。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你編劇時要解釋一位朋友為何未赴生日聚會：故事中她家兩位照顧者同時外出，她臨時照顧弟妹及處理搬家，整周都很吃力。你想寫給另一角色，說明她家庭安排承壓，並提議先問她何時方便，不解讀為不重視友情。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: Her household has come under enormous strain with the move and the sudden care responsibilities. Let us ask when she has time rather than assume she does not value the friendship.
examples.zh: 搬家加上突來的照顧責任，令她家庭安排承受極大壓力。先問她何時有空，別假定她不重視友情。

examples.en: The family came under enormous strain that week, so her absence needs to be understood in that context. I suggest sending a kind message and asking about another day.
examples.zh: 那周家庭承受極大壓力，所以需在這處境理解她缺席。我建議寄友善訊息，問另一天。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以多重家庭負擔支持強烈承壓，提出體諒及查問，不從缺席推定不在乎。

takeaways.en: The service came under enormous strain after demand rose faster than the team could respond.
takeaways.zh: 需求增長快過團隊回應能力後，服務承受極大壓力。

takeaways.en: The family came under enormous strain during the move, even though they kept the essential routines going.
takeaways.zh: 搬家期間家庭承受極大壓力，儘管仍維持必要日常安排。

sources.sentence: In public healthcare, compassion still needs structure.

brief.meaningEn: Concern for others needs an organised, workable way to become effective help.
brief.meaningZh: 對別人的關懷，需要有組織、可行的安排才能成為有效幫助。
brief.grammar: compassion still needs structure; compassion is uncountable and takes needs; structure means an organised arrangement
brief.boundaryZh: 不是以程序取代溫暖，也不是有同情便不用負責；要說清實際安排怎樣支援關懷。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是以程序取代溫暖，也不是有同情便不用負責；要說清實際安排怎樣支援關懷。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「關懷仍需要可行安排」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Transparent statement using structure as an organisation metaphor; not an indivisible fixed idiom or a healthcare policy claim.

listening.en: The neighbours wanted to help the newly arrived family, but compassion still needs structure: they agreed one contact person and a delivery list so the family did not receive five dinners on the same evening.
listening.zh: 鄰居想幫新到家庭，但關懷仍需要可行安排：他們議定一位聯絡人及送餐清單，以免同一晚收到五份晚餐。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 鄰居以聯絡人及清單協調原有善意。
這家庭要求同晚收到五份晚餐，清單只在記喜好。
清單只用來記送餐後的反應，沒有協調時段。
鄰居已沒有想幫忙的人，問題主要是招募意願。

listening.explanationZh: wanted to help 已有善意；聯絡人及清單讓幫助配合實際需要，避免重複。

reply.promptEn: Why did the neighbours agree a contact person and delivery list?
reply.promptZh: 鄰居為甚麼議定聯絡人及送餐清單？

options.en: Compassion still needs structure; the list helped their kindness reach the family in a useful way.
options.zh: 關懷仍需要可行安排；清單讓善意以有用方式送到家庭。

options.en: They wanted to coordinate the meals rather than send too many at once.
options.zh: 他們想協調餐點，而非一次送太多。

options.en: One contact person could check what was needed before others made arrangements.
options.zh: 一位聯絡人可在其他人安排前，核對需要甚麼。

options.en: The practical plan helped them turn concern into organised support.
options.zh: 實際計劃幫他們把關心轉為有組織支持。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 戲劇角色答應探望獨居鄰居，但大家都選周一、其餘日子沒人。她提議先問對方方便時間，再分開安排。哪句最能概括？

options.en: Compassion still needs structure if the visits are to fit the neighbour’s needs.
options.zh: 若探望要配合鄰居需要，關懷仍需要可行安排。

options.en: The number of willing visitors confirms that the weekly coverage is already balanced.
options.zh: 願探望的人數已確認整周安排均衡。

options.en: A visiting rota should be made without asking which times suit the neighbour.
options.zh: 探望輪值應在不問鄰居合適時間下編定。

scene.explanationZh: 善意人數與實際時間分配不同，安排需連到當事人需要。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種做法最不符合 compassion still needs structure 的意思？

options.en: 問需要後，協調誰在甚麼時間提供哪項支持。
只收集願意幫忙的名字，不議定實際工作或時間。
安排清楚聯絡方法，同時聽受助者的想法。

contrast.explanationZh: 列意願不等於可行支援，也不應把有組織與聆聽排斥。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「排清單會不會讓關心太冷冰冰，不如大家想到就送？」哪句回應最合適？

options.en: Compassion still needs structure; we can keep the warmth while checking what the family can actually use.
options.zh: 關懷仍需要可行安排；我們可保留溫暖，同時核對家庭實際用得上甚麼。

options.en: Let us send whatever we choose and ask about duplicates only after everything arrives.
options.zh: 先各自送想送的，全部到後才問有沒有重複。

options.en: Reuse last week’s delivery plan before asking whether the family’s needs have changed.
options.zh: 未問家庭需要是否改變，便沿用上周送餐安排。

dialogue.explanationZh: 協調讓關心配合需要，不必在隨意重複與只顧程序間二選一。

speaking.en: Compassion still needs structure, so we should agree how the help will reach the people who need it.
speaking.zh: 關懷仍需要可行安排，所以應議定幫助怎樣到達有需要的人。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再用實際安排支援關懷。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替故事中的校園互助小組寫招募訊息，志願者想陪新生適應，但新生不知可找誰。你想邀請每人選一個固定聯絡時段，並把新生想問的事轉到合適的人，不要求志願者無限待命。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: Compassion still needs structure, so please choose a contact time when new pupils can reach you. We can then direct their questions to the person best placed to help.
examples.zh: 關懷仍需要可行安排，所以請選一個新生能聯絡你的時段。之後可把問題轉給最適合幫忙的人。

examples.en: Our willingness to support newcomers matters, but compassion still needs structure. Let us publish agreed contact times rather than expect everyone to be available all day.
examples.zh: 支持新人的意願重要，但關懷仍需要可行安排。我們公布議定聯絡時間，不期待每人整天待命吧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用可查的聯絡時段及轉介支援新生，不以名單或無限待命代替可行安排。

takeaways.en: Compassion still needs structure when several people offer to help the same household.
takeaways.zh: 幾人同時想幫一個家庭時，關懷仍需要可行安排。

takeaways.en: The organiser knew that compassion still needs structure, so she asked what help was wanted before drawing up the rota.
takeaways.zh: 主辦者知道關懷仍需要可行安排，所以編輪值前先問想得到甚麼幫助。

sources.sentence: Keep services free where it matters most.

brief.meaningEn: In the places, areas or situations in which something has the greatest importance.
brief.meaningZh: 在某事最重要的地方、範圍或情況。
brief.grammar: focus help/use time where it matters most; where may refer to an area of action rather than a physical location
brief.boundaryZh: most 需按目標及當事人需要判斷，不自動等於最大、最貴或最顯眼；要有具體優先理由。
brief.misconceptionZh: most 需按目標及當事人需要判斷，不自動等於最大、最貴或最顯眼；要有具體優先理由。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「用在最重要的地方」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: We used the guide’s limited space where it matters most, explaining the two confusing turns rather than adding another long welcome from the committee.
listening.zh: 我們把指南有限篇幅用在最重要的地方，解釋兩個易混淆轉彎，而非再加委員會長篇歡迎語。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 篇幅集中在實際令訪客困惑的路段。
委員會歡迎語因最顯眼而得到最多篇幅。
指南增加新路線，沒有改原本含糊轉彎的說明。
訪客主要對歡迎頁有疑問，而非路線轉彎。

listening.explanationZh: 目標是幫訪客找到路，困惑轉彎比額外歡迎語更需篇幅。

reply.promptEn: Why did you shorten the welcome and explain those turns?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼縮歡迎語，改解釋那些轉彎？

options.en: We wanted to use the space where it matters most for visitors trying to follow the route.
options.zh: 我們想把篇幅用在最重要的地方，幫訪客跟路線。

options.en: The confusing turns were where readers most needed practical detail.
options.zh: 讀者最需實際細節的地方，是那些含糊轉彎。

options.en: Another welcome would not answer the questions people had about the route.
options.zh: 再加歡迎語不能回答大家對路線的疑問。

options.en: We gave priority to the points that were making the directions hard to follow.
options.zh: 我們優先處理令指引難跟的地方。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 合唱團只有一次合練，大家已熟開頭，卻在中段交接常接錯；指揮想把時間集中那裏。哪句貼切？

options.en: Let us spend the rehearsal time where it matters most, on the uncertain transition.
options.zh: 把排練時間用在最重要的地方，處理不穩的交接吧。

options.en: The most useful choice is to repeat the opening because it already sounds confident.
options.zh: 最有用選擇是重唱開頭，因為那裏已很穩。

options.en: Use the session to polish the closing passage for a strong final impression, rather than work on the uncertain handover.
options.zh: 用這節練好結尾留下深刻最後印象，而非處理不穩交接。

scene.explanationZh: 只有一次合練，已知中段交接常錯，應優先處理；不是只重做穩的開頭或先修結尾印象。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種依據最不足以判斷 where it matters most？

options.en: 哪些問題實際阻礙目前目標。
哪部分最顯眼，即使與參與者困難無關。
有限時間下，哪項處理最回應已知需要。

contrast.explanationZh: 重要性需連到目的，顯眼本身不建立優先。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「指南封面最容易被看見，把全部修改時間放封面吧？」但試用者在轉彎迷路。哪句回應最合適？

options.en: Let us work where it matters most for finding the route, starting with the unclear turns.
options.zh: 先從不清楚轉彎開始，把工夫用在最能幫找路的重要部分吧。

options.en: Use the cover’s visibility as our only criterion for deciding what to fix.
options.zh: 只用封面顯眼程度決定修甚麼。

options.en: Polish the welcome page this afternoon and leave the route review until just before printing.
options.zh: 下午先修好歡迎頁，臨印前才檢視路線。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已知困難是跟路線，優先應連到該目標。

speaking.en: We should use our limited time where it matters most, guided by what people actually need.
speaking.zh: 我們應按大家實際需要，把有限時間用在最重要的地方。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再交代重要性所依據的目標。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你要為外婆生日整理一份家族留言，不想大部分時間只做華麗封套；她最在意能讀清遠方家人的手寫字及知道誰寫的。你要向一起準備的家人提出分工。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: Let us put our effort where it matters most to Grandma: making each message readable and naming the person who wrote it. We can keep the cover simple.
examples.zh: 把工夫用在外婆最在意的地方吧：讓每段留言易讀，也寫清誰寫的。封套可以簡單。

examples.en: For this gift, let us focus where it matters most: on readable messages and clear names. One of us can check the handwriting while another confirms the names.
examples.zh: 對這份禮物，把工夫集中最重要的地方吧：易讀留言及清楚姓名。一人可核對手寫字，另一人確認姓名。

writing.selfCheckZh: 按外婆看重的可讀留言及人物連結提出分工，不只以華麗或顯眼決定投入。

takeaways.en: We put the extra explanation where it matters most, beside the step readers often misunderstand.
takeaways.zh: 我們把額外解釋放在最重要的地方，即讀者常誤會的步驟旁。

takeaways.en: She wanted to offer help where it matters most to the family, rather than guess from appearances.
takeaways.zh: 她想把幫忙用在家庭最在意的部分，而非按外表猜。

sources.sentence: Adults should get regular check-ups when advised by a clinician.

brief.meaningEn: Attend health examinations as a recurring part of the relevant plan.
brief.meaningZh: 按相關安排，持續定期接受健康檢查。
brief.grammar: get regular check-ups; check-up is a hyphenated noun in British English, not the verb check up on someone; regular does not state a universal interval
brief.boundaryZh: regular 指有持續安排，不是一定每天或某個固定年期；本課人物依專業建議安排，句型本身不決定每人的檢查內容或頻率。
brief.misconceptionZh: regular 指有持續安排，不是一定每天或某個固定年期；本課人物依專業建議安排，句型本身不決定每人的檢查內容或頻率。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「定期接受健康檢查」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Cambridge check-up definition confirms the examination noun. Source clinician-advised qualification is preserved; practice teaches attributed scheduling language rather than issuing medical recommendations.

listening.en: In the novel, Amir gets regular check-ups under the plan agreed with his clinician, and he records the next appointment instead of treating each visit as an unexpected emergency.
listening.zh: 小說中，阿米爾按與醫護人員議定的安排定期接受健康檢查，並記下下次預約，而非把每次到訪都當突發急事。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 人物有持續安排的檢查及下次預約。
每次到訪都由當天突發事故決定，沒有後續安排。
他只有打算預約，尚未記下任何下次日期。
阿米爾只有一次為工作申請而安排的檢查，沒有持續預約。

listening.explanationZh: regular、agreed plan 及 records the next appointment 表示持續且有下次安排，不是只有預約想法、突發到訪或一次入職檢查。

reply.promptEn: What does the novel tell us about Amir’s appointments?
reply.promptZh: 小說告訴我們阿米爾的預約有甚麼特點？

options.en: He gets regular check-ups according to a plan agreed with his clinician.
options.zh: 他按與醫護人員議定的安排，定期接受健康檢查。

options.en: His visits are recurring appointments, not just unexpected emergencies.
options.zh: 他的到訪是持續預約，不只是突發急事。

options.en: He keeps track of the next visit in the agreed plan.
options.zh: 他記下議定安排中的下次到訪。

options.en: He treats the next visit as something to plan for rather than an unexpected interruption.
options.zh: 他把下次到訪當需預先安排的事，而非突發打斷。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 你替小說角色做時間線，三次健康檢查均在先前議定的安排中，每次之後都記下下次日期。你要選一句簡介，沒有另列具體相隔多久。哪句最忠於這份時間線？

options.en: She gets regular check-ups as part of an ongoing plan.
options.zh: 她按持續安排定期接受健康檢查。

options.en: Each visit was arranged only after an unexpected emergency that day.
options.zh: 每次到訪都只因當天突發急事才安排。

options.en: She has discussed possible visits but has not yet agreed any dates.
options.zh: 她討論過可能到訪，但還未議定任何日期。

scene.explanationZh: 三次均按先前安排，且有下次日期，支持持續預約；不是當天急事才安排或日期仍全未定。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種資料不能只由 get regular check-ups 得知？

options.en: 檢查不是只有一次，而有持續安排。
每位讀者應在何時接受哪些檢查。
check-ups 在這裏是健康檢查的名詞。

contrast.explanationZh: 字詞描述持續檢查，不提供個別人的安排內容。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴把小說摘要寫成「阿米爾每次都遇突發急事才預約」，但他按議定計劃記下下次日期。哪句澄清最準確？

options.en: He gets regular check-ups under an agreed plan; the text does not present these visits as sudden emergencies.
options.zh: 他按議定安排定期接受健康檢查；原文沒有把這些到訪寫成突發急事。

options.en: The next date was chosen only after an unexpected urgent problem arose that morning.
options.zh: 下次日期只在當天早上出現突發急事後才選定。

options.en: He is only considering asking for an appointment and has no next date to record.
options.zh: 他只在考慮申請預約，沒有下次日期可記。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已有議定計劃及下次日期，不是當天急事才安排，也不只是尚未作實的預約想法。

speaking.en: She gets regular check-ups and checks her next appointment date before accepting another commitment.
speaking.zh: 她定期接受健康檢查，答應另一項事情前，會先查下次預約日期。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再留意持續安排及下次日期。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替短劇人物寫一段回覆，朋友想約她周三幫忙布展；她那天已有議定的例行檢查，想問可否周四來，毋須透露檢查細節。用一至兩句英文替人物有禮改約，不把這次預約寫成突發事故。

examples.en: I get regular check-ups under an agreed plan, and my next appointment is on Wednesday. Could I help with the display on Thursday instead?
examples.zh: 我按議定安排定期接受健康檢查，下次預約在周三。可否改周四來幫忙布展？

examples.en: I would like to help, but I get regular check-ups and already have a visit scheduled that day. Would Thursday work for you?
examples.zh: 我想幫忙，但我定期接受健康檢查，那天已有預約。周四你方便嗎？

writing.selfCheckZh: 用已有例行預約解釋改期並提出替代日，不補個人檢查細節、突發病情或全體適用頻率。

takeaways.en: He gets regular check-ups under the schedule he agreed with his clinician.
takeaways.zh: 他按與醫護人員議定的時間表定期接受健康檢查。

takeaways.en: She gets regular check-ups and notes the next appointment before arranging her other commitments.
takeaways.zh: 她定期接受健康檢查，安排其他事情前先記下下次預約。

lessons.titleEn: more health advice in our pockets
lessons.titleZh: 口袋裏有更多健康資訊

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: We have more health advice in our pockets than ever before.
sources.expression: more health advice in our pockets

brief.meaningEn: Greater access to health information through portable digital devices, using pockets for the devices carried there.
brief.meaningZh: 透過隨身數碼裝置更容易取得健康資訊，以口袋代指其中的裝置。
brief.grammar: have more health advice in our pockets; for one person, more health advice in his/her pocket is natural; reviewed possessives allow pocket or pockets as appropriate; advice is uncountable; name the comparison and device context
brief.boundaryZh: 可取得資訊不等於已讀懂、可靠或已改變習慣；口袋是轉喻，不是紙張一定放在衣袋。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可取得資訊不等於已讀懂、可靠或已改變習慣；口袋是轉喻，不是紙張一定放在衣袋。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「口袋裏有更多健康資訊」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: A creative metonymic comparison, not a fixed idiom. Original source comparison is retained; practice attributes the comparison to fictional users and does not recommend health content.

listening.en: Compared with the paper leaflets our family used to keep, we now have more health advice in our pockets through the clinic pages saved on our phones; I still need to read the explanation carefully.
listening.zh: 與家人以前保存的紙本單張相比，現在透過手機儲存的診所頁面，我們口袋裏有更多健康資訊；我仍需細讀解釋。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 隨身手機讓資訊更易取得，仍需讀懂內容。
所有家人已按每個頁面改變習慣。
比較的是紙本頁數，與手機取得資訊無關。
說話者已確認頁面不需再閱讀，因存下來就足夠。

listening.explanationZh: saved on phones 解釋 pockets；still read 保留取得與理解的區別。

reply.promptEn: What does the comparison with the old paper leaflets suggest?
reply.promptZh: 與舊紙本單張的比較說明甚麼？

options.en: We have more health advice in our pockets because we can carry the saved clinic pages on our phones.
options.zh: 我們可在手機隨身帶診所頁面，所以口袋裏有更多健康資訊。

options.en: The information is easier to carry and consult than the leaflets our family kept.
options.zh: 比家人以前保存的單張，資訊較易隨身帶及查看。

options.en: Our phones give us access to those pages, though saving them is not the same as understanding them.
options.zh: 手機讓我們取得那些頁面，但儲存不等於理解。

options.en: The comparison concerns access to information, not proof that we have changed our habits.
options.zh: 比較關乎取得資訊，不是證明習慣已變。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 小說角色在車上用手機打開先前儲存的健康指引，說比以前回家找單張方便；他尚未讀完。哪句貼切？

options.en: He has more health advice in his pocket through the saved pages, but still needs to read them.
options.zh: 透過儲存頁面，他的口袋裏有更多健康資訊，但仍需閱讀。

options.en: Opening the saved pages shows that he has already understood every recommendation.
options.zh: 打開頁面顯示他已明白每項建議。

options.en: The comparison mainly concerns how many printed leaflets fit in the car.
options.zh: 比較主要關乎車裏放得下多少紙本單張。

scene.explanationZh: 手機取得內容是轉喻的依據，打開不等於讀完或理解。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 more health advice in our pockets 得出？

options.en: 隨身裝置讓較多健康資訊容易取得。
只要資訊放在手機，就已證明使用者實際習慣改善。
還需了解資訊來源及使用方式，才能評估作用。

contrast.explanationZh: 可取得資訊與行為結果不同，裝置存在不是成效證據。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說：「既然頁面都存在手機，是否可寫全家已理解並採用了？」原文只說仍要細讀。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: Keep access separate from understanding and action; the saved pages do not establish what the family has done.
options.zh: 把取得、理解及行動分開；儲存頁面不能確立家人做了甚麼。

options.en: Use the saved-page count as the record of changes to the family’s habits.
options.zh: 把儲存頁面數量當家人改習慣的紀錄。

options.en: Describe the explanation as already read because it is available on the phone.
options.zh: 因手機看得到，就描述解釋已讀完。

dialogue.explanationZh: 原文仍需細讀，不能由儲存直接推成理解或採用。

speaking.en: We may have more health advice in our pockets, but access alone does not tell us how that advice is understood or used.
speaking.zh: 我們口袋裏或有更多健康資訊，但取得本身不能告訴我們內容怎樣被理解或使用。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把取得資訊與理解使用分開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替英語故事中的人物設計一份問卷，想研究手機怎樣影響她取得健康資訊。朋友只想數儲存頁數；你想另問她會否讀、從哪裏取得，而不自行宣稱習慣已有改變。用一至兩句英文提出問卷方向。

examples.en: We may have more health advice in our pockets, but our questions should ask where it comes from and whether people read it. Counting saved pages will not tell us that.
examples.zh: 我們口袋裏或有更多健康資訊，但問題應問來源及大家有沒有讀。數儲存頁面不能告訴我們那些事。

examples.en: The claim that we have more health advice in our pockets is about access, so I would ask how the character uses her phone to find it. I would not label her habits as improved without that evidence.
examples.zh: 口袋裏有更多健康資訊的說法關乎取得，所以我會問角色怎樣用手機找資訊。不會沒有證據便把習慣標為已改善。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出來源及閱讀問題，保留取得、理解與行動的區別，不由頁面數量補出習慣成果。

takeaways.en: We carry more health advice in our pockets now that the clinic’s pages can travel with us on our phones.
takeaways.zh: 診所頁面可隨手機帶着走後，我們口袋裏帶着更多健康資訊。

takeaways.en: They had more health advice in their pockets than in the old folder, but still needed time to read it.
takeaways.zh: 比舊文件夾，他們口袋裏有更多健康資訊，但仍需時間閱讀。

lessons.titleZh: 讓日常習慣更體現健康目標

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Information helps only if we have more health in our habits.

brief.meaningEn: In a crafted contrast, having daily actions that better reflect health aims rather than merely possessing advice.
brief.meaningZh: 在刻意安排的對比中，讓實際日常行動更配合健康目標，而非只擁有資訊。
brief.grammar: want/seek more health in our habits, not just more advice; health in habits is a crafted parallel metaphor, not a standard technical measure
brief.boundaryZh: 這是抽象目標與資訊的修辭對比，不是已量度的健康成果；要有實際行動線索，不能只由口號推成有效。
brief.misconceptionZh: 這是抽象目標與資訊的修辭對比，不是已量度的健康成果；要有實際行動線索，不能只由口號推成有效。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「讓日常習慣更體現健康目標」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: The full phrase is creative parallel wording paired with1656 advice in our pockets. It is not presented as a fixed idiom, a clinical outcome or a standalone scientific measure.

listening.en: In her speech, Mina said she wanted more health in our habits, not just more tips in our group chat; she asked members to explain what they had actually changed rather than list the links they had saved.
listening.zh: 米娜演說說，想讓日常習慣更體現健康目標，而不只在群組多些貼士；她請成員說實際改了甚麼，而非列儲存連結。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 她把實際日常行動與只收集資訊作對比。
她以儲存連結的數量當成習慣已改的證據。
她報告已量出每位成員健康改善的相同幅度。
她只想更換群組名稱，沒有問實際行動。

listening.explanationZh: actually changed 對比 saved links，說目標與行動，不提供量度成果。

reply.promptEn: What contrast was Mina making in the speech?
reply.promptZh: 米娜演說在作甚麼對比？

options.en: She wanted more health in our habits, not merely more advice in the chat.
options.zh: 她想讓日常習慣更體現健康目標，而不只是群組多些資訊。

options.en: She was asking about actual changes rather than the number of saved links.
options.zh: 她在問實際改變，而非儲存連結數量。

options.en: The point was to connect stated aims with daily actions.
options.zh: 重點是把所說目標連到日常行動。

options.en: Having information and changing a routine were being kept distinct.
options.zh: 擁有資訊與改日常安排，被清楚分開。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 社區刊物想把「新健康資訊頁被下載很多次」寫成生活習慣已改善，但沒有問讀者做了甚麼。哪句編輯意見最準確？

options.en: The download count alone does not show more health in our habits; we still need to ask about actual actions.
options.zh: 單憑下載次數，不能顯示日常習慣更體現健康目標；仍需問實際行動。

options.en: Each download can be recorded as a completed change to a reader’s daily routine.
options.zh: 每次下載都可記作一位讀者已完成日常習慣改變。

options.en: The count is a direct report from readers about the habits they changed.
options.zh: 那個數字是讀者直接報告已改哪些習慣。

scene.explanationZh: 下載紀錄是取得資訊，不是讀者行動報告；要談習慣，仍需了解實際做了甚麼。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 more health in our habits 這句創意對比得出？

options.en: 希望實際日常行動更配合健康目標。
只憑這句口號，就知道某項方法已改善健康。
還需具體了解行動及證據，才可判斷實際結果。

contrast.explanationZh: 修辭願望不是量度結果或方法成效證明。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說：「她談 habits，所以可把下載貼士數量當作行動紀錄吧？」哪句澄清最準確？

options.en: No, she asks what people actually changed; more health in our habits contrasts action with saved information.
options.zh: 不，她問大家實際改了甚麼；這個習慣健康目標的對比，是把行動與儲存資訊分開。

options.en: Count the links and use that total as the report of what each person changed.
options.zh: 數連結，用總數報告每人改了甚麼。

options.en: Describe the speech as a test of phone storage rather than a discussion of daily actions.
options.zh: 把演說描述成手機儲存測試，而非日常行動討論。

dialogue.explanationZh: 下載是取得資訊，不能代替實際行動的說明。

speaking.en: We want more health in our habits, not simply more advice to collect, so we need to ask what changes people mean.
speaking.zh: 我們想讓日常習慣更體現健康目標，不只收更多資訊，所以需問大家所指改變是甚麼。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再保留修辭對比與具體行動的區別。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：故事中，你和朋友想讓健康目標進入日常，朋友一直陪你準備翌日午餐、留出較從容的吃飯時間。你想寫一段私人感謝，珍惜這些實際嘗試，而不只數新買設備或聲稱已有健康成果。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: Thank you for helping us make room for more health in our habits, from preparing lunch to keeping a calmer meal break. I value those practical efforts more than another gadget.
examples.zh: 謝謝你幫我們留空間，讓日常習慣更體現健康目標，從準備午餐到保留較從容的吃飯時間。我珍惜這些實際努力，多於另一件新設備。

examples.en: Our aim was more health in our habits, and your company has helped me keep trying the small routines we chose. Thank you for preparing lunch with me rather than just sending more advice.
examples.zh: 我們的目標是讓日常習慣更體現健康目標，你的陪伴幫我繼續嘗試所選的小安排。謝謝你與我備午餐，而不只傳更多資訊。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以備餐及留吃飯時間感謝具體支持，分清正在嘗試的習慣與只添設備，不報告未給的健康成果。

takeaways.en: The club’s call for more health in our habits prompted questions about daily actions rather than new purchases.
takeaways.zh: 社團呼籲讓日常習慣更體現健康目標，引發對日常行動的提問，而非新購物品。

takeaways.en: She wanted more health in our habits, but first asked what that ambition would mean in ordinary life.
takeaways.zh: 她想讓日常習慣更體現健康目標，但先問這志向在平常生活中指甚麼。

lessons.titleZh: 忙碌趕路中匆匆吃東西

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Shift workers often eat on the run.

brief.meaningEn: Eat hurriedly while busy with other activities or moving between places.
brief.meaningZh: 忙其他事或在不同地方之間趕路時，匆匆吃東西。
brief.grammar: eat on the run; ate in past; on the run here means hurried while busy, not necessarily literally running
brief.boundaryZh: 不是每次外出用餐都算，也不提供食物好壞或健康後果的判斷；需有趕時間或同時忙其他事的情境。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是每次外出用餐都算，也不提供食物好壞或健康後果的判斷；需有趕時間或同時忙其他事的情境。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「忙碌趕路中匆匆吃東西」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: During the tour, we ate on the run between the station and the museum, finishing our sandwiches while checking which entrance the group should use.
listening.zh: 導覽途中，我們在車站與博物館之間趕路時匆匆吃三文治，同時核對小組應用哪個入口。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 大家趕到下一個地方時，匆匆吃東西並忙其他事。
大家在預留一小時的餐桌慢慢吃，之後才查入口。
大家先完成入口核對，之後才停下來吃午餐。
大家已結束導覽，才到車站會合吃晚餐。

listening.explanationZh: while checking 表示吃東西與核入口同時發生，並且趕往下一處，不是核完才悠閒吃或已結束導覽。

reply.promptEn: How did you manage lunch during the tour?
reply.promptZh: 導覽途中，你們怎樣吃午餐？

options.en: We ate on the run while moving from the station to the museum.
options.zh: 我們由車站到博物館的途中匆匆吃。

options.en: We finished sandwiches while checking the entrance arrangements.
options.zh: 我們核入口安排時吃完三文治。

options.en: There was no settled lunch stop; we fitted the food in between places.
options.zh: 沒有固定午餐停留，我們在地方之間趕路時抽空吃。

options.en: Lunch happened alongside the work of getting the group to the museum.
options.zh: 午餐與帶小組到博物館的工作同時進行。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 店員當天不停補貨及接客，只在兩次送貨之間邊看清單邊吃幾口飯，沒有坐下慢慢吃。哪句貼切？

options.en: She was eating on the run during the busy shift.
options.zh: 忙碌當值時，她匆匆吃東西。

options.en: She had a long uninterrupted meal before returning to the list.
options.zh: 她先不受打擾地吃一頓長飯，再看清單。

options.en: Her meal was leisurely simply because she stayed inside the shop.
options.zh: 只因留在店裏，她那頓飯就是悠閒地吃。

scene.explanationZh: 忙碌中抽空吃支持片語，不需實際跑步或走出店。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種情況最不像 eat on the run？

options.en: 趕下個會議途中，一邊確認時間一邊吃三文治。
留一段不趕急時間，坐下專心與朋友慢慢用餐。
繁忙工作間隙，只能抽空吃幾口。

contrast.explanationZh: 關鍵是匆忙與忙其他事，不是只看是否在外吃。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「你當時沒有跑，仍可說 eating on the run？」你是在兩次送貨之間匆匆吃。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: Yes, it describes eating in a hurry while busy; it does not require literal running.
options.zh: 可以，它形容忙碌中匆忙吃，不需要真的跑步。

options.en: No, remaining inside the shop means the meal must count as leisurely.
options.zh: 不，留在店裏表示那頓飯必定算悠閒。

options.en: It simply means getting a takeaway rather than cooking at home, even if the meal is unhurried.
options.zh: 它只表示買外賣而非在家煮，即使用餐並不匆忙。

dialogue.explanationZh: on the run 描述忙碌中匆忙吃的節奏，不要求實際跑步；是否外賣、是否留在店裏，都不能單獨決定用餐匆忙或悠閒。

speaking.en: We ate on the run because there was only a short gap between the two visits.
speaking.zh: 兩次到訪之間只有短空檔，所以我們匆匆吃東西。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再用忙碌與時間理解片語。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友邀你再趕一個周末活動，你近來每頓午餐都在兩地之間匆匆吃，想提議這次留一小時坐下談天。用一至兩句英文回覆邀請，表明是調整安排，不是拒絕見面。

examples.en: I have been eating on the run all week, so could we leave an hour for a proper lunch and a conversation this time? I would still love to see you.
examples.zh: 我整周都匆匆吃東西，所以這次可否留一小時好好吃午餐及談天？我仍很想見你。

examples.en: Rather than eat on the run between another two activities, I would like us to sit down and catch up. Could we choose a quieter part of the afternoon?
examples.zh: 與其又在兩個活動間匆匆吃，我想坐下與你聊聊近況。可否選下午較不趕的一段時間？

writing.selfCheckZh: 用匆忙近況說明想調整用餐安排，保留見朋友的意願，不把外食一律說成匆忙。

takeaways.en: He ate on the run between deliveries, with barely time to finish his sandwich.
takeaways.zh: 他在送貨之間匆匆吃，幾乎沒時間吃完三文治。

takeaways.en: We did not want to eat on the run again, so we left a proper gap between the visits.
takeaways.zh: 我們不想又匆匆吃，所以在兩次到訪間留了足夠空檔。

lessons.titleZh: 身體終會顯出累積的影響

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Poor sleep may seem harmless, but the body eventually keeps score.

brief.meaningEn: An expressive way to say that repeated experiences or habits can leave bodily effects over time.
brief.meaningZh: 以帶修辭的方式，說反覆經歷或習慣隨時間可能在身體留下影響。
brief.grammar: the body eventually keeps score; personification plus a scorekeeping metaphor; explain the experience and observed effect in context
brief.boundaryZh: 不是身體真有分數表，也不是任何特定習慣必定造成某疾病的規則；本課描寫人物對累積疲累的反思，不能代替具體證據。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是身體真有分數表，也不是任何特定習慣必定造成某疾病的規則；本課描寫人物對累積疲累的反思，不能代替具體證據。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「身體終會顯出累積的影響」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: The guide calls the whole statement fixed. It is taught as figurative personification rather than a medical law; original poor-sleep source sentence is preserved without prescribing a routine or predicting disease.

listening.en: After weeks of late-night editing, Jo wrote, “The body eventually keeps score,” recalling how she struggled to stay alert through an ordinary afternoon with friends.
listening.zh: 連續數周深夜編稿後，喬寫「身體終會顯出累積影響」，回想與朋友共度平常下午時，她怎樣難以保持精神。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 喬以記分比喻反思累積經歷與自身疲倦。
喬報告醫護人員已確認她疲倦的確切原因。
喬認為那些深夜工作與她現在的感受沒有關係。
喬說自己只累了一分鐘，與先前數周經歷無關。

listening.explanationZh: 數周編稿及個人疲倦，支持對累積影響的反思；沒有醫護確認，也不是與先前經歷無關的單次感受。

reply.promptEn: What does Jo’s scorekeeping image express in the memoir?
reply.promptZh: 喬在回憶錄的記分意象表達甚麼？

options.en: By saying the body eventually keeps score, she reflects on the tiredness that followed those weeks.
options.zh: 她說身體終會顯出累積影響，是在反思那些日子後的疲倦。

options.en: She connects her present fatigue with a longer pattern of late-night work.
options.zh: 她把目前疲倦連到較長期的深夜工作模式。

options.en: The image gives a personal sense of accumulated effects rather than a literal number.
options.zh: 意象表達個人的累積影響感，而非實際數字。

options.en: She is looking back at how the repeated experience seemed to affect her.
options.zh: 她在回看反覆經歷似乎怎樣影響自己。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 回憶錄人物接連隨團排練及長途往返，期待已久的家庭重聚時卻需提早離席休息；他反思自己一直忽略累積疲倦。哪句貼切？

options.en: At the reunion, he felt the body eventually keeps score after the repeated rehearsals and journeys.
options.zh: 重聚時，他在反覆排練及旅程後，感到身體終會顯出累積影響。

options.en: He left early because he had lost interest in meeting his family, rather than because he felt tired.
options.zh: 他早離開是因不再想見家人，而非覺疲倦。

options.en: His reflection concerns only that day’s long lunch, with the earlier travel left out of the account.
options.zh: 他的反思只關當天長午餐，敘述沒包括早前旅程。

scene.explanationZh: 期待重聚但因累積疲倦提早休息，支持反思身體感受；不是失去家庭興趣，也不只談當天午餐。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 the body eventually keeps score 得出？

options.en: 說話者在用累積記錄的意象談身體經驗。
這句比喻本身可確定某個人的病因及結果。
仍需具體資料，才能了解某次經歷造成甚麼影響。

contrast.explanationZh: 修辭反思不能獨立確立診斷或因果結論。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把回憶錄這句話改成「身體已計出一個可診斷疾病的分數」，原文只描述個人疲累。哪句澄清較準確？

options.en: It is a metaphor for accumulated effects in her account, not a reported medical score.
options.zh: 這是她敘述中累積影響的比喻，不是已報告的醫學分數。

options.en: Treat the image as the result of a test even though no test is mentioned.
options.zh: 即使沒提測試，也把意象當測試結果。

options.en: Describe the fatigue as a one-off reaction and leave the repeated late nights out of the interpretation.
options.zh: 把疲倦說成一次反應，解讀時不考慮反覆深夜工作。

dialogue.explanationZh: 保留人物敘述的反覆經歷及比喻性質，不補不存在的測試。

speaking.en: After the long run of late rehearsals, I felt worn out at lunch and thought, “The body eventually keeps score.”
speaking.zh: 接連深夜排練後，我午餐時覺得疲憊，心想：「身體終會顯出累積影響。」
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再用累積經歷及當時感受理解比喻。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替故事人物寫給社團的回覆。他過去幾周接了太多夜間義工工作，已常感疲倦；這次想有禮拒絕再帶一個晚間小組，肯定計劃價值但承認自身負擔。用一至兩句英文表達，不替人物下診斷。

examples.en: I value the project, but the body eventually keeps score, and I am already tired after weeks of extra evening duties. I cannot lead another group this month.
examples.zh: 我重視計劃，但身體終會顯出累積影響，幾周額外晚間工作後，我已覺疲倦。這個月我不能再帶一組。

examples.en: For me, the body eventually keeps score; I need to acknowledge the tiredness rather than add another evening commitment. Thank you for asking, but I must decline this time.
examples.zh: 對我而言，身體終會顯出累積影響；我需承認疲倦，而非再加晚間承諾。謝謝邀請，但這次必須婉拒。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用既有疲倦及累積工作支持人物反思，禮貌拒絕新增責任，不把比喻當病名或對所有人結果的預測。

takeaways.en: He wrote that the body eventually keeps score after reflecting on weeks of ignoring his own fatigue.
takeaways.zh: 他回想數周忽略自身疲倦後，寫下身體終會顯出累積影響。

takeaways.en: For the narrator, the body eventually keeps score meant that the repeated late nights no longer felt consequence-free.
takeaways.zh: 對敘事者來說，身體終會顯出累積影響，意思是反覆深夜工作不再讓他覺得毫無代價。

lessons.titleEn: carry stress around like extra luggage
lessons.titleZh: 像多帶行李般一直背着壓力

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Many workers carry stress around like extra luggage.
sources.expression: carry stress around like extra luggage

brief.meaningEn: Continue feeling burdened by stress across situations, as though carrying an extra load.
brief.meaningZh: 像背着額外負擔般，在不同處境中仍持續感到壓力。
brief.grammar: carry stress around like extra luggage; carries/carried/carrying; simile links stress with a load
brief.boundaryZh: 是負擔與持續性的比喻，不是行李重量，也不代表角色不能有片刻放鬆；需交代壓力從哪裏延續到哪裏。
brief.misconceptionZh: 是負擔與持續性的比喻，不是行李重量，也不代表角色不能有片刻放鬆；需交代壓力從哪裏延續到哪裏。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「像多帶行李般一直背着壓力」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: I carried stress around like extra luggage after the difficult rehearsal, still replaying the argument while I cooked dinner with my flatmate.
listening.zh: 艱難排練後，我像多帶行李般一直背着壓力，與室友煮飯時仍反覆想那場爭論。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 排練的壓力延續到與室友煮飯的時段。
壓力在排練一完就消失，晚飯只談食譜。
室友已解決排練分歧，所以說話者在回顧結果。
那場爭論只發生在晚飯，與排練沒有關係。

listening.explanationZh: after rehearsal 及 still replaying while dinner 交代負擔跨情境延續。

reply.promptEn: What do you mean when you say the stress followed you home?
reply.promptZh: 你說壓力跟你回家，是甚麼意思？

options.en: I carried stress around like extra luggage and kept replaying the rehearsal argument over dinner.
options.zh: 我像多帶行李般一直背着壓力，晚飯仍反覆想排練爭論。

options.en: My attention stayed on the disagreement even while I was cooking with my flatmate.
options.zh: 即使與室友煮飯，我的注意仍留在分歧上。

options.en: The worry did not stay inside the rehearsal room.
options.zh: 擔心並沒有只留在排練房。

options.en: I felt burdened by the same issue in a different part of the day.
options.zh: 在當天另一段時間，我仍感到同一問題的負擔。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 角色與家人郊遊，仍不斷想未解的工作指責，很難留意身旁風景；你要形容負擔延續，不是說她真的多拿行李。哪句貼切？

options.en: She carries stress around like extra luggage even on the family outing.
options.zh: 即使家庭郊遊，她仍像多帶行李般背着壓力。

options.en: The work issue is no longer on her mind once the outing starts.
options.zh: 郊遊一開始，她已不再想工作問題。

options.en: The remaining worry began during the outing and concerns a new family disagreement, rather than the work criticism.
options.zh: 仍有的擔心在郊遊才開始，關乎新的家庭分歧，而非工作指責。

scene.explanationZh: 她在郊遊仍想工作指責，顯示原有負擔延續；不是已不再想，也不是新的家庭分歧。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 carry stress around like extra luggage 得出？

options.en: 壓力像額外負擔，跨越原本情境而延續。
人物一離開原來地方，就代表原問題已處理完畢。
需要前後線索，才知壓力怎樣延續到另一處境。

contrast.explanationZh: 比喻強調負擔延續，離開地方並不確立問題已解。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「離開排練房就該沒事了，晚飯怎會仍想那件事？」哪句回應較準確？

options.en: I was carrying stress around like extra luggage; leaving the room did not immediately end the worry.
options.zh: 我像多帶行李般一直背着壓力；離開房間沒有立即停止擔心。

options.en: I was mainly worried about finishing dinner, not about what happened at rehearsal.
options.zh: 我主要擔心煮不完晚飯，不是在想排練發生的事。

options.en: I was planning a new rehearsal activity rather than replaying the argument.
options.zh: 我是在計劃新排練活動，而非反覆想爭論。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已給線索是反覆想排練爭論，原有負擔延續；不是晚餐壓力或規劃新活動。

speaking.en: She carried stress around like extra luggage, even when the conversation had moved to something pleasant.
speaking.zh: 即使談話已轉到愉快事情，她仍像多帶行李般背着壓力。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明負擔跨情境延續。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你答應參加朋友的輕鬆飯聚，但發現自己仍掛住昨日被否定的企劃。你想有禮說明為何偶爾走神，請朋友容許你先說幾分鐘，再投入聚會，而不是指責朋友。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: I am carrying stress around like extra luggage after yesterday’s rejection, which is why I seem distracted. Could I talk for a few minutes before we settle into the evening?
examples.zh: 昨日被拒後，我像多帶行李般一直背着壓力，所以看來走神。正式投入今晚聚會前，可否讓我談幾分鐘？

examples.en: I do want to enjoy dinner with you, but I have been carrying stress around like extra luggage from that meeting. Please give me a moment to explain what is still on my mind.
examples.zh: 我真想享受與你晚飯，但一直像多帶行李般背着那次會議的壓力。請給我片刻說明仍掛心的事。

writing.selfCheckZh: 說明舊事負擔與當下走神的關係，有禮提出有限談話請求，不把壓力歸咎朋友或聲稱談完必定消失。

takeaways.en: He carried stress around like extra luggage from the office into the quiet weekend.
takeaways.zh: 他把辦公室的壓力像額外行李般，帶進安靜周末。

takeaways.en: I was carrying stress around like extra luggage, so the friendly conversation took a while to reach me.
takeaways.zh: 我像多帶行李般背着壓力，所以友善談話過了一會才進到心裏。

lessons.titleEn: the quiet architecture of everyday habits
lessons.titleZh: 日常小習慣形成的無形架構

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Good health rests on the quiet architecture of everyday habits.
sources.expression: the quiet architecture of everyday habits

brief.meaningEn: The unobtrusive structure created by ordinary repeated actions that supports and shapes daily life.
brief.meaningZh: 平常反覆行動形成、不太顯眼卻支撐及塑造生活的架構。
brief.grammar: rest on/be shaped by the quiet architecture of everyday habits; architecture is an extended structure metaphor
brief.boundaryZh: quiet 指不顯眼，不一定沒有聲音；比喻需有具體日常支撐，不是說習慣可單獨保證某結果。
brief.misconceptionZh: quiet 指不顯眼，不一定沒有聲音；比喻需有具體日常支撐，不是說習慣可單獨保證某結果。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「日常小習慣形成的無形架構」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: A deliberately poetic extended metaphor rather than a fixed idiom. The supplied health sentence remains provenance; new models describe ordinary routines without medical guarantees.

listening.en: My teaching week rested on the quiet architecture of everyday habits: preparing the next folder before leaving and noting one question after each class kept small tasks from getting lost.
listening.zh: 我的教學周靠日常小習慣的無形架構支撐：離開前備好下一個文件夾、每課後記一條問題，讓小工作不易遺漏。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 不顯眼的重複安排支撐日常工作。
教學周主要靠一次大型整理，之後不再有日常動作。
支持教學周的主要因素是換了新課本，而非那些日常小安排。
那些小安排只在整周工作結束後才首次出現。

listening.explanationZh: 備文件夾及課後記問題是反覆日常支撐，不是單次大整理、新課本或整周過後才開始。

reply.promptEn: What helped keep the small teaching tasks from getting lost?
reply.promptZh: 甚麼幫你避免遺漏教學小工作？

options.en: The quiet architecture of everyday habits supported the week, especially preparing folders and noting questions.
options.zh: 日常小習慣的無形架構支撐那一周，尤其備文件夾及記問題。

options.en: I used small repeatable actions rather than rely on remembering everything at once.
options.zh: 我用可重複小行動，而非一次記住全部事。

options.en: The ordinary routines made space for the next class and its questions.
options.zh: 平常安排為下一課及其問題留了位置。

options.en: Preparing before leaving and making a short note afterwards gave the week a useful structure.
options.zh: 離開前準備、課後寫短記，給那一周實用架構。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 小說人物每晚把鑰匙放同一碟、把翌日要交的信放門旁，早上較少四處找東西；作者想形容不顯眼日常支撐。哪句貼切？

options.en: Her mornings were supported by the quiet architecture of everyday habits.
options.zh: 她的早晨由日常小習慣的無形架構支撐。

options.en: The author describes a single morning when she rearranged the whole house.
options.zh: 作者描述她一次早晨重排整間房子。

options.en: The arrangements were mainly a one-off display for visitors, not something she relied on each morning.
options.zh: 那些安排主要是一次給訪客看的展示，不是她每天早晨依靠的做法。

scene.explanationZh: 每晚放好鑰匙及信件，形成早晨可依靠的重複安排，不是一次重排或訪客展示。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種解讀最符合 the quiet architecture of everyday habits？

options.en: 不顯眼的小動作累積成可依靠的生活架構。
只描述總共工作多少小時，而不涉及反覆行動怎樣支撐日常。
一次重大宣布本身已等於可持續的反覆習慣。

contrast.explanationZh: 重點是平常動作怎樣形成結構，不是單看時數或一次宣布。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「她只在周末大整理一次，architecture 應指那次全面重排吧？」前文卻說每晚放鑰匙及備信。哪句澄清最準確？

options.en: The image comes from the repeated actions that support her mornings, not a single large clear-out.
options.zh: 意象來自支撐早晨的反覆動作，不是單次大整理。

options.en: The weekend clear-out is the main event, and the nightly actions have no part in the image.
options.zh: 周末大整理才是主事件，每晚動作與意象無關。

options.en: The image concerns how much time she worked, rather than the structure of her routine.
options.zh: 意象關乎她工作多少時間，而非日常安排的結構。

dialogue.explanationZh: 前文反覆小動作支持日常結構的讀法，不能改成一次整理或單看工時。

speaking.en: The quiet architecture of everyday habits can be easy to overlook until a familiar routine changes.
speaking.zh: 日常小習慣的無形架構很容易被忽略，直到熟悉安排改變。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再用具體反覆行動理解結構比喻。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你加入一個小型合奏團，看到團員每次先一起調音、結束後記下下一次要留意的地方；這些低調安排幫新團員跟上。你想在致謝短訊中珍惜這種反覆支持，並請同伴教你如何參與。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: I appreciate the quiet architecture of everyday habits in this ensemble, from tuning together to leaving notes for the next rehearsal. Could you show me how to contribute to those routines?
examples.zh: 我珍惜這合奏團日常小習慣的無形架構，從一起調音到為下次排練留筆記。可否教我怎樣參與這些安排？

examples.en: The quiet architecture of everyday habits helps a new member like me find a place in the ensemble. Thank you for the repeated care; I would like to learn how to help with the rehearsal notes.
examples.zh: 日常小習慣的無形架構，幫助像我這樣的新團員在合奏團找到位置。謝謝反覆的照顧；我想學怎樣協助記排練筆記。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用調音及筆記說明反覆但低調的支持，表達感謝並請求參與，不把架構只當實際建築或一次大型表演。

takeaways.en: The quiet architecture of everyday habits held the busy household together in small, practical ways.
takeaways.zh: 日常小習慣的無形架構，以細小實際方式維繫忙碌家庭。

takeaways.en: She noticed the quiet architecture of everyday habits when she began managing the mornings on her own.
takeaways.zh: 她開始獨自打理早晨時，留意到日常小習慣的無形架構。

lessons.titleZh: 長期負荷下耗盡精力或熱情

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Volunteers can burn out without regular breaks.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Volunteers can burn out without regular breaks.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Volunteers can burn out without regular breaks.

brief.meaningEn: Become exhausted or lose the energy and enthusiasm to continue after prolonged pressure or overwork.
brief.meaningZh: 長時間壓力或過多工作後，疲憊到失去繼續的精力或熱情。
brief.grammar: people burn out; burned/burnt out; burning out; two-word verb differs from the noun burnout
brief.boundaryZh: 不是普通一刻累，也不必指字面燒毀；用語本身不是診斷，需有長期負擔及持續難以投入的情境。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是普通一刻累，也不必指字面燒毀；用語本身不是診斷，需有長期負擔及持續難以投入的情境。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「長期負荷下耗盡精力或熱情」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: In the story, the club organiser began to burn out after months of taking every evening shift; she felt drained even before opening the next planning message and no longer enjoyed work she once loved.
listening.zh: 故事中，社團主辦者連續數月接下每晚當值後，開始耗盡精力與熱情；未開下一則籌備訊息已覺疲憊，也不再享受曾喜歡的工作。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 長期負荷後，她持續疲憊並失去原有投入感。
她只在一場活動後累片刻，翌日已完全如常。
她因得到更有趣的新角色而主動轉職。
她仍非常享受每晚工作，問題只是一次訊息延遲。

listening.explanationZh: months、drained before next message 及 no longer enjoyed 給持續負荷線索，不是一刻累或單次延遲。

reply.promptEn: Why does the story suggest that the organiser is struggling to continue?
reply.promptZh: 故事為甚麼顯示主辦者很難繼續？

options.en: She began to burn out after carrying every evening shift for months.
options.zh: 連續數月接下每晚當值後，她開始耗盡精力與熱情。

options.en: The work left her drained even before she opened the next planning message.
options.zh: 她甚至未打開下一則籌備訊息，已因工作覺得疲憊。

options.en: She had lost the enjoyment she used to find in organising the club.
options.zh: 她失去以往籌辦社團的樂趣。

options.en: The repeated workload was affecting her ability to engage with the next task.
options.zh: 反覆負荷影響她投入下項工作的能力。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 小說中的設計師長時間接連趕案，幾周來對新稿提不起勁，休息一晚仍覺難以投入；敘述沒有下診斷。哪句語言描述貼切？

options.en: The character seems to be burning out after the prolonged workload.
options.zh: 角色長期負荷後，似乎正耗盡精力與熱情。

options.en: The passage describes only a brief burst of tiredness during one otherwise enjoyable evening.
options.zh: 段落只描述一個其他時候都愉快的晚上，短暫累了一下。

options.en: The character has found a new enthusiasm for taking on more projects.
options.zh: 角色對接更多項目找到了新熱情。

scene.explanationZh: 幾周持續難投入是用語線索，seems 保留描述而非診斷。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持這裏的 burn out？

options.en: 長期負荷後，持續感到耗竭並失去以往投入感。
一場愉快遊戲後暫時有點累，片刻後又想繼續。
接連數月工作後，未開始新任務已覺耗盡。

contrast.explanationZh: 一刻疲累本身不足以表達此處的長期耗竭。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「她幾周都說提不起勁，只是今晚不喜歡一則訊息吧？」哪句回應較準確？

options.en: The story describes a longer pattern of burning out, not just a reaction to tonight’s message.
options.zh: 故事描寫較長期的耗竭模式，不只是對今晚訊息的反應。

options.en: We can explain the whole passage by the wording of this one message alone.
options.zh: 可只用這一則訊息的措辭，解釋整段經歷。

options.en: Her main reason is probably a new role with more interesting tasks, rather than exhaustion from the old duties.
options.zh: 她主要原因大概是有任務較有趣的新角色，而非舊職責帶來的耗竭。

dialogue.explanationZh: 故事給長期負荷及投入漸失的線索，不只是單次訊息，也沒提新角色吸引她離開。

speaking.en: The character began to burn out under the prolonged workload, even though she still cared about the club.
speaking.zh: 長期工作負荷下，角色開始耗盡精力與熱情，儘管仍在乎社團。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清長期耗竭與一刻疲倦。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：故事中，姑母連續數月替大家安排家族舊照片的訪問和每晚訊息，現在對新請求既疲憊又失去以往熱情。你想有保留地說出擔心，具體提出接手兩周的預約訊息，並問她最需要甚麼幫忙。用一至兩句英文寫給她。

examples.en: I worry that you may be burning out after months of handling the interviews and evening messages. Could I take over the booking messages for two weeks, and what else would help?
examples.zh: 我擔心你數月處理訪問及晚間訊息後，可能正耗盡精力與熱情。可否讓我接手兩周預約訊息，還有甚麼會有幫助？

examples.en: You still care about the family project, but I am concerned that you are beginning to burn out under the repeated workload. I can handle the bookings for a fortnight if that would help you.
examples.zh: 你仍在乎家族計劃，但我擔心反覆工作負荷令你開始耗竭。若有幫助，我可以接手兩周預約。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以長期負荷及失去投入感表達有保留的擔心，提出明確可詢問的幫助，不替對方診斷或把耗竭等同不在乎。

takeaways.en: She feared she would burn out if she kept accepting every evening duty in the story.
takeaways.zh: 故事中，她擔心若繼續接下每晚工作，會耗盡精力與熱情。

takeaways.en: The narrator shows him burning out through a lasting loss of energy for work he once enjoyed.
takeaways.zh: 敘事者透過他對曾享受工作持續失去精力，呈現耗竭。

sources.sentence: Some people go all in on a new diet.

brief.meaningEn: Commit fully to a plan or activity rather than hold back.
brief.meaningZh: 對計劃或活動全力投入，而非保留。
brief.grammar: go all in on/with a project; went all in; informal commitment expression with a gambling origin
brief.boundaryZh: 投入程度高，不自動等於魯莽、必定成功或一次完成；需看投入甚麼及實際選擇。
brief.misconceptionZh: 投入程度高，不自動等於魯莽、必定成功或一次完成；需看投入甚麼及實際選擇。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「全力投入」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Once the group agreed on the play, Maya went all in on the production, setting aside her free evenings for rehearsals and working closely with the cast; the performance was still ahead.
listening.zh: 小組議定劇目後，瑪雅全力投入製作，騰出空閒晚上排練並與演員緊密合作；演出仍未到。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 她把時間及心力充分投入已選的製作。
她已演完劇目，句子只在報告觀眾結果。
她仍只旁觀，尚未答應花時間參與。
她把排練全部壓在同一晚完成，而非持續投入。

listening.explanationZh: free evenings 及 working closely 說投入程度，不是演出結果或一次全做。

reply.promptEn: How did Maya respond once the play was chosen?
reply.promptZh: 劇目選定後，瑪雅怎樣回應？

options.en: She went all in on the production and committed her free evenings to it.
options.zh: 她全力投入製作，把空閒晚上留給它。

options.en: She gave the rehearsals a firm place in her schedule.
options.zh: 她在時間表為排練留了確定位置。

options.en: She worked closely with the cast rather than stay at the edge of the project.
options.zh: 她與演員緊密合作，而非只在計劃邊緣旁觀。

options.en: She committed strongly to making the agreed production happen.
options.zh: 她認真全力投入，讓已議定製作成事。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 朋友已查清攝影展時限及所需工作，決定接下策展、預留周末並與團隊協作；展覽尚未開。哪句貼切？

options.en: He is ready to go all in on the exhibition after checking what it involves.
options.zh: 查清所需工作後，他準備全力投入展覽。

options.en: His commitment confirms that the exhibition has already attracted its audience.
options.zh: 他的投入確認展覽已吸引觀眾。

options.en: He has decided to make only an occasional suggestion without joining the work.
options.zh: 他決定只偶爾提意見，不加入工作。

scene.explanationZh: 查清後投入時間與責任符合片語，未確立觀眾結果。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 went all in 得出？

options.en: 人物對指定事情充分投入。
人物已完成整項活動並得到成功結果。
情境應交代他投入的時間、心力或其他選擇。

contrast.explanationZh: 投入是承諾程度，與最後成果不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「她全力投入，就表示不用再討論分工，反正她會做吧？」哪句回應最合適？

options.en: Going all in shows her commitment, but we should still agree which responsibilities belong to each person.
options.zh: 全力投入顯示她的承諾，但仍應議定每人的責任。

options.en: Treat her enthusiasm as acceptance of the tasks nobody else has chosen.
options.zh: 把她的熱誠當成接受其他人未選的工作。

options.en: Wait for her to complete the production before asking what help she wanted.
options.zh: 等她做完整項製作，才問想要甚麼幫忙。

dialogue.explanationZh: 充分投入不代替清楚協作，也不默認包辦。

speaking.en: I want to go all in on the project, with a clear understanding of what I am committing to.
speaking.zh: 我想全力投入計劃，也清楚了解自己承諾甚麼。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把投入程度與成果分開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你試過幾次與街坊一起記錄鳥聲，發現自己很喜歡，想寫給小組主辦者申請加入長期整理及每周分享，並問清資料格式。你想表達願意認真投入，不暗示已是專家。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: After the trial walks, I would like to go all in on the sound-recording project and join the weekly sharing. Could you send me the format for the files and notes?
examples.zh: 試走幾次後，我想全力投入聲音記錄計劃，參加每周分享。可否寄檔案及筆記格式給我？

examples.en: I am ready to go all in on organising the recordings, rather than just drop in occasionally. Please tell me what I should prepare for the next session.
examples.zh: 我準備全力投入整理錄音，而非只偶爾到訪。請告訴我下次活動應準備甚麼。

writing.selfCheckZh: 表達持續投入並問實際格式，不把熱誠當已具專業能力或成果已達。

takeaways.en: They went all in on the local history project after agreeing how to share the work.
takeaways.zh: 議定分工後，他們全力投入地方史計劃。

takeaways.en: She chose to go all in with the new ensemble, leaving regular time for rehearsals.
takeaways.zh: 她選擇全力投入新樂團，固定留時間排練。

lessons.titleZh: 把所有享受的事都刪去

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: They need not cut out everything they enjoy.

brief.meaningEn: Remove every enjoyable activity or item from a routine, with the complete scope supplied by everything.
brief.meaningZh: 從日常安排刪去每一項享受的活動或事物，everything 表示全部。
brief.grammar: cut out everything they enjoy; cut is also past tense; need not cut out expresses that complete removal is unnecessary
brief.boundaryZh: cut out 這裏是刪去或不再做，不是字面剪紙；everything 的範圍及 need not 的否定不能漏，不等於只減少某一部分。
brief.misconceptionZh: cut out 這裏是刪去或不再做，不是字面剪紙；everything 的範圍及 need not 的否定不能漏，不等於只減少某一部分。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「把所有享受的事都刪去」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: To finish the family album, we did not need to cut out everything we enjoy; we kept our weekly games night and moved one editing session to a quieter morning.
listening.zh: 要完成家族相簿，我們不需要刪去所有享受的事；保留每周遊戲夜，把一次編輯移到較安靜早上。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 小組調整一項安排，並非刪掉所有享受。
小組已取消每周遊戲夜，改成每晚編輯。
小組完全沒有改時間，仍按原有編輯安排。
每周遊戲夜與編輯同時進行，是句子描述的解決方法。

listening.explanationZh: did not need、kept games night、moved one session 支持非全面刪除而作局部調整。

reply.promptEn: Did working on the album mean giving up all your enjoyable activities?
reply.promptZh: 做相簿是否表示要放棄所有享受的活動？

options.en: No, we did not need to cut out everything we enjoy; we changed one editing time.
options.zh: 不是，我們不用刪去所有享受的事；只改了一次編輯時間。

options.en: We kept the weekly games night and edited at a different time.
options.zh: 我們保留每周遊戲夜，在另一時段編輯。

options.en: The plan needed an adjustment rather than a complete loss of leisure.
options.zh: 計劃需要調整，而非完全失去休閒。

options.en: We made room for the project without cancelling every activity we liked.
options.zh: 我們為計劃留時間，沒取消每項喜歡的活動。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 小說角色想學新語言，原以為要取消所有興趣，後來選每天一小段練習並保留周六合唱。哪句貼切？

options.en: She need not cut out everything she enjoys to make room for practice.
options.zh: 她不需要刪去所有享受的事，也可為練習留時間。

options.en: She has abandoned every hobby, including the Saturday choir.
options.zh: 她已放棄每項興趣，包括周六合唱。

options.en: She treats the choir as the language practice itself, rather than keeping both activities.
options.zh: 她把合唱本身當成語言練習，而非保留兩項活動。

scene.explanationZh: 題目是短語言練習與周六合唱並存，不是全棄興趣，也沒把合唱說成語言練習本身。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 need not cut out everything they enjoy 得出？

options.en: 不一定要全面取消喜歡的事物。
已經刪去全部享受，只是事後認為不值得。
可考慮局部調整，保留某些喜歡的活動。

contrast.explanationZh: need not 是不必，不是已經全面刪除的過去結果。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「既然不用全部放棄，那就完全不用改時間吧？」但你們已把一節編輯移到早上。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: We need not cut out everything we enjoy, but we did make a specific change to fit the work in.
options.zh: 我們不用刪去所有享受的事，但確有一項具體調整讓工作放得下。

options.en: Keeping the games night means the original editing time never changed.
options.zh: 保留遊戲夜表示原編輯時間從沒改過。

options.en: Move the editing back to the same evening and assume the two activities will fit without discussion.
options.zh: 把編輯移回同晚，未討論便假定兩活動放得下。

dialogue.explanationZh: 非全面刪除與局部改時間可同時成立，不能把不必全放棄改成完全無調整。

speaking.en: We need not cut out everything we enjoy, but we should be clear about the change we are making.
speaking.zh: 我們不需要刪去所有享受的事，但應清楚說明正在作的調整。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再保留 need not 與 everything 的範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友以為為社團省一筆場地費，就要刪去所有喜歡的活動。你們其實只取消一次昂貴外借場，保留免費公園畫畫及家中閱讀會。你要有禮說明這項局部取捨。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: We need not cut out everything we enjoy; we can keep the park drawing and home reading sessions while dropping one costly venue booking.
examples.zh: 我們不用刪去所有享受的事；可保留公園畫畫及家中閱讀，同時取消一次昂貴場地預約。

examples.en: Cancelling that booking does not mean we must cut out everything we enjoy. Let us keep the activities that work without the extra venue cost.
examples.zh: 取消那項預約，不表示必須刪去所有享受的事。保留不用額外場地費也可進行的活動吧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 清楚區分取消一項與全面刪去，列出保留活動，不把取捨說成完全無改變或全盤放棄。

takeaways.en: They did not have to cut out everything they enjoy when they revised the busy timetable.
takeaways.zh: 修訂繁忙時間表時，他們不必刪去所有享受的事。

takeaways.en: She thought she must cut out everything she enjoys, until she found room for a smaller change.
takeaways.zh: 她以為必須刪去所有享受的事，直到找到較小調整的空間。

lessons.titleZh: 在某種環境中發揮得很好

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Some students thrive in small classes.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Some students thrive in small classes.

brief.meaningEn: Develop or perform very well in a particular environment or set of conditions.
brief.meaningZh: 在特定環境或條件下，發展或表現得很好。
brief.grammar: thrive in a small group/a lively setting; thriving drops e; specify the conditions and observed strengths
brief.boundaryZh: 不是只身處某環境，也不保證同一環境人人適合；需要表現或成長線索，不由個人例子推普遍規則。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是只身處某環境，也不保證同一環境人人適合；需要表現或成長線索，不由個人例子推普遍規則。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「在某種環境中發揮得很好」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Nora thrives in a small discussion group, where she has time to shape a question and respond to others; in the large lecture she had mostly stayed quiet.
listening.zh: 諾拉在小組討論發揮很好，有時間組織問題並回應別人；在大型講座，她原本大多沉默。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 小組條件讓她更能主動發問及回應。
她只是坐在小組內，敘述沒有任何參與表現。
她在大型講座已一直主導討論，小組反而只旁聽。
例子主要顯示上課時間縮短，而非她參與方式改變。

listening.explanationZh: 組織問題及回應別人顯示個人參與改善；不是只到場、原已主導或上課長度改變。

reply.promptEn: What seems to suit Nora about the small group?
reply.promptZh: 小組有甚麼似乎適合諾拉？

options.en: She thrives in that setting because she has time to form questions and respond.
options.zh: 她在那環境發揮很好，因有時間組織問題及回應。

options.en: The pace gives her room to contribute rather than remain silent.
options.zh: 節奏讓她有空間貢獻，而非保持沉默。

options.en: She can take an active part in a way she did not in the large lecture.
options.zh: 她能以大型講座中未有的方式主動參與。

options.en: The discussion conditions bring out her curiosity and responses.
options.zh: 討論條件讓她的好奇及回應發揮出來。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 角色在有明確期限但可自行安排方法的工作室，持續提出作品及改進，較以往逐步被指示時更投入。哪句貼切？

options.en: She thrives in a setting that combines clear deadlines with freedom over the method.
options.zh: 她在期限清楚、方法有自主的環境發揮很好。

options.en: She is present in the studio but has not produced or revised any work.
options.zh: 她在工作室，但沒有製作或修改任何作品。

options.en: The example shows that deadlines prevent her from contributing.
options.zh: 這例子顯示期限阻止她作貢獻。

scene.explanationZh: 持續製作改進支持發揮很好，條件是清楚期限加方法自主。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 thrives in this setting？

options.en: 持續主動參與，作品及理解有進展。
只知道人物出現在該處，沒任何發展或表現資料。
特定條件讓人物比原來更能發揮長處。

contrast.explanationZh: thrive 不只是到場，需要發展或表現的依據。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「她在小組發揮好，那全班都應改同一方式，不用再問吧？」哪句回應較準確？

options.en: She thrives in that setting, but we should ask what helps the other students rather than assume the same fit.
options.zh: 她在那環境發揮好，但應問其他學生需要甚麼，而非假定一樣適合。

options.en: Use her experience as the complete evidence for every student’s preference.
options.zh: 把她的經驗當每位學生偏好的完整證據。

options.en: Change next week’s whole-class format before asking the others which conditions help them.
options.zh: 未問其他人哪些條件幫到他們，就先改下周全班方式。

dialogue.explanationZh: 諾拉的例子提供個人適配依據，不能代替了解其他人的需要，或在詢問前替全班定案。

speaking.en: She thrives in a setting that gives her time to think and a clear chance to contribute.
speaking.zh: 她在有時間思考、也有清楚貢獻機會的環境發揮很好。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再用具體表現支持環境適配。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替朋友申請圖書館接待義工寫介紹。她在有清楚分工又可與人直接交流的環境特別投入，曾在社區攤位主動幫訪客找資料；但仍需學圖書館系統。用一至兩句英文支持推薦，保留培訓需要。

examples.en: She thrives in roles with clear responsibilities and direct contact with people, as I saw when she helped visitors at our community stall. She would still need training in the library system.
examples.zh: 她在責任清楚、能直接與人交流的角色發揮很好，我在社區攤位看過她幫訪客。她仍需接受圖書館系統培訓。

examples.en: I think she would thrive in your welcome team because she listens carefully and enjoys finding the right information for visitors. A guided introduction to the system would help her begin.
examples.zh: 她仔細聆聽，也喜歡替訪客找合適資料，所以我想她會在你的接待團隊發揮很好。有人帶領認識系統，可幫她開始。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以接待互動的實際表現支持角色適配，保留學系統需要，不把熱誠說成已掌握全部工作。

takeaways.en: He thrived in the workshop because he could turn questions into small experiments.
takeaways.zh: 他在工作坊發揮很好，因可把問題轉成小實驗。

takeaways.en: The group thrived in a setting where different ideas could be tested without rushing to one answer.
takeaways.zh: 小組在能測試不同想法、不急於定唯一答案的環境發展得很好。

lessons.titleEn: gently pull life in a better direction
lessons.titleZh: 慢慢把生活帶向較好方向

target.pattern: \bgently pull(?:s|ed|ing)? life in a better direction\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Small habits can gently pull life in a better direction.
sources.expression: gently pull life in a better direction

brief.meaningEn: Gradually guide daily life towards an improvement through modest actions.
brief.meaningZh: 透過不大的行動，逐漸把日常生活帶向改善。
brief.grammar: small changes gently pull life in a better direction; gently suggests modest influence, not a forceful total change
brief.boundaryZh: 需說清對人物而言改善在哪，不保證所有困難消失，也不是真有人拉動生活；是方向及程度比喻。
brief.misconceptionZh: 需說清對人物而言改善在哪，不保證所有困難消失，也不是真有人拉動生活；是方向及程度比喻。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「慢慢把生活帶向較好方向」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Keeping tomorrow’s materials by the door began to gently pull life in a better direction for me: the mornings felt less rushed, though I still had a demanding journey ahead.
listening.zh: 把翌日材料放門旁，開始慢慢把我的生活帶向較好方向：早晨沒那麼趕，儘管接着仍有辛苦路程。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 一項小安排帶來人物認為有用的漸進改善。
人物已不需再出門，所有行程都取消。
材料被放回原處，早晨節奏沒有改變。
主要變化是旅程路線已縮短，而非早晨安排。

listening.explanationZh: less rushed 是指定改善，still demanding journey 保留未改的部分。

reply.promptEn: What changed when you prepared the materials by the door?
reply.promptZh: 把材料預先放門旁後，有甚麼改變？

options.en: It began to gently pull life in a better direction by making my mornings less rushed.
options.zh: 它讓早晨沒那麼趕，開始慢慢把生活帶向較好方向。

options.en: I could begin the day with less searching and hurry.
options.zh: 我可少些找東西及匆忙地開始一天。

options.en: The small routine improved one part of the day without changing the whole journey.
options.zh: 小安排改善當天一部分，沒有改整段路程。

options.en: I felt a modest but useful shift in how the morning worked.
options.zh: 我感到早晨運作有不大卻有用的轉變。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物每周留一小段時間整理待回的私人信件，漸漸少忘記朋友生日；她想形容日常連結慢慢改善，不是一次全改生活。哪句貼切？

options.en: The small habit can gently pull life in a better direction for her.
options.zh: 那小習慣可慢慢把她的生活帶向較好方向。

options.en: The birthday messages show that she has replaced her entire weekly routine at once.
options.zh: 生日訊息顯示她已一次換掉整周日常安排。

options.en: Although she keeps the list, her birthday responses have not changed.
options.zh: 儘管保留清單，她回應生日的方式沒有改變。

scene.explanationZh: 漸漸少忘記生日支持生活連結逐步改善，不是全周一次重排，也不是回應毫無改變。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 gently pull life in a better direction 得出？

options.en: 小改變可逐漸帶來人物重視的改善。
這項小改變本身已等於一次全面重排整個生活。
要有具體生活線索，才知道 better 對人物指甚麼。

contrast.explanationZh: gently 及 direction 表示溫和漸進的方向，不等於一次全面重排。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「既然早晨沒那麼趕，往返路程也已變短了吧？」原文說路程仍辛苦。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: The change helped the morning routine, not the length of the journey; better direction has a specific scope here.
options.zh: 改變幫到早晨安排，不是路程長度；這裏較好方向有指定範圍。

options.en: The calmer morning is enough to establish that the journey takes fewer minutes.
options.zh: 早晨較從容已足以確立路程少了幾分鐘。

options.en: We should describe the preparation as useless because the journey remains demanding.
options.zh: 路程仍辛苦，所以應把準備描述為無用。

dialogue.explanationZh: 一部分改善與另一部分未變可並存，不推未給的路程數字或全盤無用。

speaking.en: A modest change can gently pull life in a better direction without replacing everything we already do.
speaking.zh: 一項不大的改變可慢慢把生活帶向較好方向，而不用替換所有現有做法。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再保留漸進改善的程度。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你想寫給搬到外地的姐姐，提議每周互寄一小段聲音分享普通日常，慢慢維繫連結；不用每次都安排很長正式通話。用一至兩句英文作溫和邀請，不承諾距離的困難全部消失。

examples.en: Perhaps a short voice message each week could gently pull life in a better direction for us, keeping ordinary moments in our conversation. We need not wait for a long formal call.
examples.zh: 也許每周一小段語音，可慢慢把我們的生活帶向較好方向，讓談話保留平常片刻。不必等長篇正式通話。

examples.en: I would like us to try one small weekly exchange that might gently pull life in a better direction. Hearing a little about your day would help me feel more connected.
examples.zh: 我想試每周一點小交流，或可慢慢把生活帶向較好方向。聽一點你當天的事，會讓我覺得更有連結。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以小交流及連結感說明希望的改善，保留或可的程度，不把邀請當全部距離困難已解。

takeaways.en: The new routine seemed to gently pull life in a better direction by leaving room for a calmer start.
takeaways.zh: 新安排留出較從容起步的空間，似乎慢慢把生活帶向較好方向。

takeaways.en: Small reliable exchanges can gently pull life in a better direction for people who have lost touch.
takeaways.zh: 對疏了聯絡的人，細小可靠的交流可慢慢把生活帶向較好方向。

sources.sentence: Health rarely comes from one dramatic reset.

brief.meaningEn: A single striking attempt to restart or reorganise a situation comprehensively.
brief.meaningZh: 一次顯著、全面重新開始或重排情況的嘗試。
brief.grammar: hope for/plan/avoid one dramatic reset; reset is a restart metaphor, dramatic modifies the scale
brief.boundaryZh: 描述改動方式及幅度，不自動證明有用或持久；one 與漸進多次有別，也不表示必須全部推翻。
brief.misconceptionZh: 描述改動方式及幅度，不自動證明有用或持久；one 與漸進多次有別，也不表示必須全部推翻。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「一次徹底的大改動」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The committee hoped one dramatic reset of the whole timetable would settle the recurring clashes, but the first discussion showed that they still needed to ask each group about its actual availability.
listening.zh: 委員會希望一次全面重排時間表，能處理反覆衝突；但首次討論顯示，仍需問各組實際空檔。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 小組想一次全面改安排，但仍需具體了解各組時間。
The committee planned a trial change to one clashing slot before considering any wider redesign.
options.zh: 委員會計劃先試改一個衝突時段，才考慮更大重排。

options.en: 每組已確認新時段，討論只在宣布結果。
首次討論是先前多次小改動的最後一次記錄，沒有全面重排想法。

listening.explanationZh: whole timetable 及 one dramatic reset 是一次全面重排的希望，不是先試一個時段；hoped 也不等於已取得各組確認。

reply.promptEn: What was the committee hoping the timetable change would do?
reply.promptZh: 委員會希望時間表改動做到甚麼？

options.en: They hoped one dramatic reset would deal with the repeated clashes.
options.zh: 他們希望一次徹底大改動，能處理反覆衝突。

options.en: They wanted a comprehensive restart rather than another small adjustment.
options.zh: 他們想全面重來，而非再作小調整。

options.en: The plan was to reorganise the whole timetable in one major move.
options.zh: 計劃是一次大行動重排整份時間表。

options.en: They were seeking a broad change, although individual availability still needed checking.
options.zh: 他們在尋求大幅改變，儘管仍需核對各人空檔。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物想把舊寫作計劃全部撤下，換全新題目、時段及合作人，稱這是一次重開；尚未試新安排。哪句貼切？

options.en: She is planning one dramatic reset rather than a minor revision.
options.zh: 她在計劃一次徹底大改動，而非小修訂。

options.en: The new plan has already proved easier to sustain over several months.
options.zh: 新計劃已證實數月都較易維持。

options.en: She has kept the topic, times and collaborators unchanged and altered only the title.
options.zh: 她保留題目、時段及合作者不變，只改標題。

scene.explanationZh: 三項根本安排都換支持大改動，未試不證明可持續。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 one dramatic reset 得出？

options.en: 一次顯著而幅度大的重新安排。
大改動的成果已確立，往後不用再檢視。
可與許多小步調整的方式作比較。

contrast.explanationZh: 幅度不保證成果或免去後續檢視。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「整張時間表重排過，就不用再問每組可用時間了吧？」哪句回應最合適？

options.en: One dramatic reset does not supply that information; we still need each group’s availability.
options.zh: 一次徹底大改動不會提供那些資料；仍需各組空檔。

options.en: Use the scale of the redesign as evidence that every new slot suits its group.
options.zh: 以重排幅度作為每個新時段都適合該組的證據。

options.en: Ask about availability only after publishing the complete new timetable.
options.zh: 先公布完整新時間表，之後才問空檔。

dialogue.explanationZh: 重排與取得資料不同，需在確定安排前核對。

speaking.en: One dramatic reset may look decisive, but we still need to understand what the new arrangement requires.
speaking.zh: 一次徹底大改動可能看來果斷，但仍需了解新安排要求甚麼。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清改動幅度與實際結果。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友看你的一章初稿不順，就想你刪掉整本重新開始；你想先問讀者在哪段失去線索，試改那章，而不立即重寫全部。用一至兩句英文回覆，承認大改可能是一種選項，但不把它當目前已證實的唯一需要。

examples.en: Before choosing one dramatic reset of the whole book, I would like to ask where readers lose the thread. A focused revision of this chapter may tell us more.
examples.zh: 選擇整本一次大改前，我想先問讀者在哪裏失去線索。針對修改這章，或可讓我們知道更多。

examples.en: One dramatic reset is an option, but I have not yet found out what makes the chapter hard to follow. Let us get that feedback before deciding how much to rewrite.
examples.zh: 一次徹底大改動是選項，但我還未弄清這章為何難跟。決定重寫多少前，先取得那些回饋吧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 保留大改作為未定選項，提出先查具體困難，不由一章不順直接推整本必須重來。

takeaways.en: He wanted one dramatic reset of his working week, not another minor change to a single evening.
takeaways.zh: 他想對工作周作一次徹底大改動，而非再微調一個晚上。

takeaways.en: One dramatic reset of the project left the team with new roles that still needed explaining.
takeaways.zh: 計劃一次徹底大改動後，團隊有新角色，仍需解釋。

sources.sentence: One workout once in a blue moon will not change much.

brief.meaningEn: Very rarely, with long gaps between occasions.
brief.meaningZh: 極少發生，兩次之間相隔很久。
brief.grammar: visit/use something once in a blue moon; informal frequency idiom, not a specified calendar interval
brief.boundaryZh: 比偶爾更強地強調罕有，但不是永不，也不提供精確月份或次數。
brief.misconceptionZh: 比偶爾更強地強調罕有，但不是永不，也不提供精確月份或次數。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「極少，難得一次」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: I see my old school friend once in a blue moon now that we live so far apart, so the unexpected afternoon together felt especially precious.
listening.zh: 我們相隔很遠後，我極少見到舊同學，所以意外一起度過的下午特別珍貴。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 兩人見面很罕有，這次因而難得。
兩人每周按固定時間見面，所以這次只是例行。
說話者認為兩人從來沒有見過。
句子指定兩人每隔某個確切月數就會見面。

listening.explanationZh: so far apart 及 especially precious 支持罕有，未給精確間隔，也不是從未見。

reply.promptEn: Why did that afternoon with your school friend feel precious?
reply.promptZh: 與舊同學的下午為甚麼珍貴？

options.en: We see each other once in a blue moon because we live far apart.
options.zh: 我們住得遠，極少見面。

options.en: There are usually long gaps between our meetings.
options.zh: 我們見面通常相隔很久。

options.en: It was a rare chance to spend time together.
options.zh: 那是難得一起相處的機會。

options.en: The distance means we do not often get an afternoon like that.
options.zh: 距離令我們不常有那種下午。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一個偏遠村落極少有戲團到訪，隔多年才又有一場，村民很期待；你不知確切間隔。哪句貼切？

options.en: A theatre group comes here once in a blue moon.
options.zh: 戲團極少到這裏。

options.en: A theatre group performs here every week as part of a regular season.
options.zh: 戲團在這裏每周作季度例行演出。

options.en: The account gives an exact monthly interval for every visit.
options.zh: 敘述提供每次到訪確切相隔月數。

scene.explanationZh: 多年難得一次符合片語，不是每周或已知精確月數。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 once in a blue moon 得出？

options.en: 事情發生得很罕有。
事情從未發生，而且往後不可能發生。
情境可交代為何這次機會值得珍惜。

contrast.explanationZh: 很少不等於從未或永不。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「你說極少見，即是從沒見過吧？」但你們剛共度下午。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: Once in a blue moon means rarely, not never; this afternoon was one of those rare meetings.
options.zh: once in a blue moon 是極少，不是從不；這下午就是罕有見面之一。

options.en: The rare afternoon should be counted as an ordinary weekly meeting.
options.zh: 那罕有下午應算一般每周見面。

options.en: The phrase supplies the exact number of months since the previous meeting.
options.zh: 片語提供上次見面後確切相隔月數。

dialogue.explanationZh: 片語給模糊頻率程度，不抹去已發生見面或提供日曆數字。

speaking.en: We meet once in a blue moon, so I want to leave time to hear what has changed in her life.
speaking.zh: 我們極少見面，所以我想留時間聽她生活有甚麼改變。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再保留很少與從不的差別。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你家有一件製麵工具，幾年才用一次，親戚想借去辦小型示範；你想有禮答應，解釋它平常極少使用，並請對方約歸還日。用一至兩句英文回覆，不說從來未用過。

examples.en: We use the noodle maker once in a blue moon, so you are welcome to borrow it for the demonstration. Could we agree a return date?
examples.zh: 我們極少用製麵工具，所以歡迎你借去示範。可否議定歸還日？

examples.en: It comes out of the cupboard once in a blue moon, rather than every weekend. I am happy to lend it if we arrange when it will come back.
examples.zh: 它極少從櫃裏拿出來，不是每周末都用。若約好何時歸還，我很樂意借出。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用極少使用支持借用回覆，保留歸還安排，不把罕有改成從未使用或某個固定頻率。

takeaways.en: She visits the old village once in a blue moon, but still remembers the route to her aunt’s house.
takeaways.zh: 她極少回舊村，但仍記得去姨母家的路。

takeaways.en: The special projector is used once in a blue moon, when someone brings an old film to share.
takeaways.zh: 有人帶舊影片分享時，那特別投影機才難得用一次。

sources.sentence: Good intentions can run out of steam after long shifts.

brief.meaningEn: Lose the energy, enthusiasm or momentum needed to continue.
brief.meaningZh: 失去繼續所需的精力、熱情或推進動力。
brief.grammar: people/projects run out of steam; ran in past; context can describe temporary energy loss or a project losing momentum
brief.boundaryZh: 不是蒸汽機的字面描述，也不單憑這片語就代表永久失敗、失去能力或診斷；要看人物或計劃怎樣停滯。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是蒸汽機的字面描述，也不單憑這片語就代表永久失敗、失去能力或診斷；要看人物或計劃怎樣停滯。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「漸漸失去精力或動力」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The history group ran out of steam after the first burst of interviews: messages went unanswered and nobody suggested the next visit, although several stories remained to collect.
listening.zh: 歷史小組在首輪訪問熱潮後失去動力：訊息沒人回，也沒人提下次到訪，儘管仍有幾段故事待收集。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 小組後來失去推進動力，工作仍未完成。
所有故事已收齊，訊息只在宣布結束。
小組剛獲更多人手，開始安排更密集訪問。
停滯主要因所有受訪者已取消，並非組員不再推進。

listening.explanationZh: unanswered、nobody suggested 與 remained 表示動力下降而未完成，不提供外部取消原因。

reply.promptEn: Why did the next visits not get organised?
reply.promptZh: 下幾次到訪為甚麼沒安排？

options.en: The group ran out of steam after the early burst of interviews.
options.zh: 首輪訪問熱潮後，小組失去推進動力。

options.en: People stopped replying and no one proposed the next visit.
options.zh: 大家不再回覆，也沒人提下次到訪。

options.en: The initial enthusiasm did not carry through to the remaining work.
options.zh: 最初熱誠沒延續到剩餘工作。

options.en: The project lost momentum even though stories were still waiting to be collected.
options.zh: 即使故事仍待收集，計劃也失去動力。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物寫了三章後暫時沒新點子，坐着改同一句而沒有推進；她仍想完成故事。哪句貼切？

options.en: She has run out of steam for the moment, though she still wants to finish.
options.zh: 她暫時失去推進動力，儘管仍想完成。

options.en: She has completed the entire story and is only choosing where to publish it.
options.zh: 她已完成全故事，只在選哪裏刊登。

options.en: The passage says she has decided never to write again.
options.zh: 段落說她已決定永不再寫。

scene.explanationZh: 暫時不推進不等於已完成，也不確立永久放棄。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 ran out of steam 得出？

options.en: 當時繼續的精力或推進動力下降。
日後已不可能再繼續或找到新動力。
需看上下文才知道是人累了、熱誠下降還是計劃停滯。

contrast.explanationZh: 當時失去動力不決定所有往後可能。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「幾周都沒人回覆，不如先公布完整新一季，大家自然會跟上？」訪問工作尚未重開。哪句回應最合適？

options.en: We have run out of steam, so let us agree one manageable visit and ask who can help before promising a full season.
options.zh: 我們已失去動力，所以承諾整季前，先議定一次可應付的到訪，問誰能幫。

options.en: Wait until the whole group feels as enthusiastic as it did at the start before discussing any next step.
options.zh: 等整組人都像最初一樣熱誠，才討論任何下一步。

options.en: Publish the full season now and find out afterwards whether anyone has time to organise it.
options.zh: 現在公布整季，之後才了解有沒有人有空籌辦。

dialogue.explanationZh: 先確認可行的一小步及人手，不靠等熱誠全恢復，或先承諾未問過的完整安排。

speaking.en: We ran out of steam before the work was finished, so I want to agree one realistic next step.
speaking.zh: 工作未完，我們已失去動力，所以我想議定一個實際下一步。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再把動力下降與工作完成分開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：逛了一整天市集後，你暫時沒精力再走，朋友卻以為你不喜歡今天的行程。你想澄清自己只是精力不繼，提議坐下喝茶，聊聊最喜歡的攤位。用一至兩句英文回應，保留對行程的興趣。

examples.en: I have run out of steam after walking all day, but I really enjoyed the market. Could we sit down for tea and talk about our favourite stalls?
examples.zh: 走了一整天，我已沒精力，但我很享受市集。可否坐下喝茶，聊聊我們最喜歡的攤位？

examples.en: I am running out of steam, not losing interest in the day we have shared. I would love a quiet cup of tea and a chance to hear which stall you liked best.
examples.zh: 我正精力不繼，不是對一起度過的日子失去興趣。我很想安靜喝茶，聽你最喜歡哪個攤位。

writing.selfCheckZh: 分清暫時精力不繼與不喜歡行程，以具體較輕鬆的相處提議維持交流，不把疲累寫成永久失去興趣。

takeaways.en: The discussion ran out of steam when nobody could suggest a useful next question.
takeaways.zh: 沒人能提出有用下一問時，討論失去推進動力。

takeaways.en: I was running out of steam by the final page, though I still wanted to finish the letter carefully.
takeaways.zh: 到最後一頁，我的精力漸漸不繼，儘管仍想小心寫完信。
