sources.sentence: Younger athletes may try to level it up.

brief.meaningEn: Improve something or make it more advanced than its current standard.
brief.meaningZh: 把某事改善，或提升到比目前更高的程度。
brief.grammar: level it up; levelled/levelling in British English; it needs a named antecedent; informal and related to game levels
brief.boundaryZh: 不一定是實際遊戲分數，也不只是加更多內容；需說明提升哪項品質或挑戰，不保證結果。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不一定是實際遊戲分數，也不只是加更多內容；需說明提升哪項品質或挑戰，不保證結果。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「把它提升一個層次」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: The guide labels the expression a set phrase. Level up is treated as an informal phrasal verb; the supplied it lacks its wider answer antecedent, so every practice context names the item being improved.

listening.en: The board game prototype already worked, but we wanted to level it up by giving players a meaningful choice each turn, rather than simply adding more cards with the same effect.
listening.zh: 桌上遊戲原型已能運作，但我們想讓每回合有具意義的選擇來提升它，而不只是加更多效果一樣的卡。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 小組想改善玩家決策的品質，而非只增加同類卡。
原型已在比賽取得更高分數，句子在報告名次。
小組認為卡越多便越好，不需改玩家選擇。
原型從未能運作，小組決定完全棄掉遊戲。

listening.explanationZh: it 指原型，meaningful choice 對比 more same-effect cards，界定想提升的品質。

reply.promptEn: What did you want to improve in the prototype?
reply.promptZh: 你們想改善原型哪方面？

options.en: We wanted to level it up by making each turn involve a meaningful choice.
options.zh: 我們想讓每回合有具意義選擇，把它提升一個層次。

options.en: Players needed more interesting decisions, not just more copies of the same effect.
options.zh: 玩家需要更有趣的決策，而非更多一樣效果。

options.en: The aim was to improve the quality of the choices within a game that already worked.
options.zh: 目標是改善已能運作遊戲中的選擇品質。

options.en: We hoped to make the play more engaging without merely increasing the card count.
options.zh: 我們希望遊玩更投入，而非只增加卡數。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 你的口頭介紹已有清楚內容，想用一個貼切對比及更順的轉接提升說服力，不只是再加兩頁資料。哪句貼切？

options.en: The introduction is clear, and I want to level it up with a sharper comparison and smoother transitions.
options.zh: 介紹已清楚，我想以更貼切對比及更順轉接提升它。

options.en: The introduction needs only a higher page count, regardless of how the argument connects.
options.zh: 介紹只需更多頁，與論點怎樣連接無關。

options.en: The introduction needs a longer list of facts before the links between its ideas are considered.
options.zh: 介紹需先列更長事實清單，才考慮意念之間的連接。

scene.explanationZh: 目標是對比及轉接品質，不是先增加頁數或事實清單。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說明 level it up 的具體提升？

options.en: 指出原本限制，提出能改善體驗的改動。
只把頁數或物件數加倍，不說品質有甚麼變化。
說明由目前標準向哪個較高要求前進。

contrast.explanationZh: 提升不只數量，需有品質或挑戰方面的目標。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「卡加倍就是把遊戲提升吧？」但新卡效果都一樣。哪句回應最合適？

options.en: To level it up, we should ask what decision becomes more interesting, not just count the cards.
options.zh: 要提升它，應問哪項決策更有趣，而非只數卡。

options.en: Use the bigger deck as the complete test of whether the game improved.
options.zh: 把較大牌組當遊戲有沒有改善的完整測試。

options.en: Add the same effects again before deciding what players find repetitive.
options.zh: 未決定玩家覺得甚麼重複，就再加同樣效果。

dialogue.explanationZh: 具體品質目標引導改動，數量本身不提供改善證據。

speaking.en: The basic plan works, and I want to level it up by making the choices clearer and more engaging.
speaking.zh: 基本計劃可行，而我想讓選擇更清楚、更投入，來提升它。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再找出 it 指甚麼及提升哪方面。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們的社區食譜小冊已收齊做法，但讀者找菜式時要逐頁翻。你想向編輯提出下一版提升方法：按主要食材加索引，讓讀者容易找，而不只再加更多食譜。用一至兩句英文提出目標及請求意見。

examples.en: Our recipe booklet is complete, but I want to level it up with an index of the main ingredients. Could you help us check whether readers can find a dish more easily?
examples.zh: 食譜小冊已完整，但我想用主要食材索引提升它。可否幫我們檢查讀者是否更容易找到菜式？

examples.en: The booklet has enough recipes; we could level it up by improving how people search for a dish. I would value your advice on a clear ingredient index.
examples.zh: 小冊已有足夠食譜；我們可透過改善找菜式的方法提升它。我希望得到你對清楚食材索引的意見。

writing.selfCheckZh: 先指明小冊已有內容，再提出按食材查找的品質目標及回饋請求，不把更多食譜自動當提升。

takeaways.en: The simple game worked, and the team wanted to level it up with choices that rewarded careful thought.
takeaways.zh: 簡單遊戲可行，而團隊想用重視仔細思考的選擇提升它。

takeaways.en: Her first presentation was clear; feedback helped her see how she might level it up next time.
takeaways.zh: 她首個簡報清楚；回饋讓她看見下次或可怎樣提升它。

lessons.titleEn: singing from the same song sheet

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The teams are not singing from the same song sheet.
sources.expression: singing from the same song sheet

brief.meaningEn: Share a consistent understanding or approach so that actions or messages align.
brief.meaningZh: 有一致的理解或做法，讓行動或訊息互相配合。
brief.grammar: be singing from the same song sheet; sang/have sung; agreement concerns the relevant issue, not all personal opinions
brief.boundaryZh: 不是真的唱歌，也不要求所有想法完全一樣；要指明需一致的是資料、目標或處理方式。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是真的唱歌，也不要求所有想法完全一樣；要指明需一致的是資料、目標或處理方式。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「對做法有一致理解」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The two welcome teams were not singing from the same song sheet: one told visitors to register before the tour, while the other said to join first and register later.
listening.zh: 兩個接待團隊對做法理解不一致：一組叫訪客導賞前登記，另一組說先參加、之後再登記。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 兩組給訪客的登記先後指引互相矛盾。
兩組使用不同語氣，但給的是同樣登記步驟。
兩組已確認一套新流程，訪客只在問例外。
分別只在導賞路線長短，沒有涉及登記時間。

listening.explanationZh: before 對比 later 明確指出流程理解不一致，不只是說話風格不同。

reply.promptEn: Why were visitors confused about registration?
reply.promptZh: 訪客為甚麼對登記感到困惑？

options.en: The teams were not singing from the same song sheet about when to register.
options.zh: 團隊對何時登記的做法理解不一致。

options.en: One team said to register before the tour, and the other said afterwards.
options.zh: 一組說導賞前登記，另一組說之後。

options.en: The instructions gave conflicting sequences for the same process.
options.zh: 同一流程的指引給了互相矛盾的先後。

options.en: Visitors heard two different answers to the same practical question.
options.zh: 訪客對同一實際問題，聽到兩種不同答案。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 展覽兩位講者先議定哪些內容已核實、哪些仍不確定，之後各自用不同例子講解；你要說事實範圍一致，不是風格相同。哪句貼切？

options.en: They are singing from the same song sheet on the evidence, even though their examples differ.
options.zh: 儘管例子不同，他們對證據範圍有一致理解。

options.en: Using different examples shows that they disagree about which facts were checked.
options.zh: 用不同例子，顯示他們對哪些事實已核有分歧。

options.en: Agreement on the evidence requires them to repeat every sentence in the same style.
options.zh: 對證據一致，要求他們以同樣風格重複每句。

scene.explanationZh: 一致的是證據範圍，個人例子及風格仍可不同。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 singing from the same song sheet 得出？

options.en: 對相關做法或理解互相配合。
每個人的所有意見及表達風格都完全相同。
仍需上下文指出正在協調哪項事情。

contrast.explanationZh: 一致有具體範圍，不擴成所有個人意見相同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說：「兩組語氣都很親切，就算協調好了吧？」但登記先後仍不同。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: A friendly tone is not enough; we need to sing from the same song sheet on the registration sequence.
options.zh: 語氣親切仍不足；我們需對登記先後有一致理解。

options.en: Use the shared friendly tone as confirmation that the instructions match.
options.zh: 把共同親切語氣當指引一致的確認。

options.en: Let each team keep its sequence and ask visitors to choose which one sounds nicer.
options.zh: 讓各組保留自己的先後，請訪客選哪個聽來較好。

dialogue.explanationZh: 需核對實際流程，不能用語氣或讓訪客選喜好代替協調。

speaking.en: We need to sing from the same song sheet on the practical arrangements, even if we explain them in different styles.
speaking.zh: 即使用不同風格解釋，我們仍需對實際安排有一致理解。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再保留一致所指的具體範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你和同伴剛完成工作坊導師會議，已議定學生可交一次修訂、回饋分為內容與表達兩部分，接着各人用自己的例子教學。你想寫一段會後致謝，肯定同伴逐項核對讓大家有共同說明，也珍惜各人風格。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: Thank you for checking the revision and feedback arrangements with us; we are now singing from the same song sheet on those points. I appreciate having a common account for students while keeping our own examples.
examples.zh: 謝謝你與我們核對修訂及回饋安排；現在大家對這些要點有一致理解。我珍惜可向學生作共同說明，又保留各自例子。

examples.en: We are singing from the same song sheet about the revision opportunity and the two areas of feedback after today’s meeting. Thank you for helping us align the framework without asking us to teach in identical styles.
examples.zh: 今天會議後，我們對修訂機會及兩部分回饋有一致理解。謝謝你幫我們協調框架，而不要求以完全一樣的風格教學。

writing.selfCheckZh: 感謝已完成的具體協調，交代共同修訂及回饋框架，保留例子和教學風格差異，不只重述先前分歧。

takeaways.en: The organisers began singing from the same song sheet once they agreed the order of the visits.
takeaways.zh: 議定到訪先後後，主辦者開始對做法有一致理解。

takeaways.en: We can sing from the same song sheet on the goal without using identical examples.
takeaways.zh: 我們可對目標有一致理解，而不用完全相同例子。

lessons.titleEn: sit back and take it easy

target.pattern: \bsit(?:s|ting)? back and tak(?:e|es|ing) it easy\b|\bsat back and took it easy\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: He refused to sit back and take it easy after retirement.
sources.expression: sit back and take it easy

brief.meaningEn: Relax and avoid demanding effort for a period.
brief.meaningZh: 在一段時間放鬆，避免太費力的活動。
brief.grammar: sit back and take it easy; sat back and took it easy in past; paired relaxation expression
brief.boundaryZh: 可以是自在選擇，不自動等於懶惰、永久放棄或不重視別人；需看當時責任、意願及時間範圍。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可以是自在選擇，不自動等於懶惰、永久放棄或不重視別人；需看當時責任、意願及時間範圍。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「放鬆一下，輕鬆過日子」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: After hosting the family gathering, Martha wanted to sit back and take it easy the next morning, while the others made breakfast and decided their own plans.
listening.zh: 主持家庭聚會後，瑪莎翌晨想放鬆一下，其他人做早餐並各自決定計劃。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 她想在忙完聚會後，翌晨暫時輕鬆一下。
她已決定從此不再參與任何家庭活動。
她仍在指揮每項早餐工作，沒有交給其他人。
其他人正在等待她主持另一場同樣繁忙的聚會。

listening.explanationZh: after hosting 及 next morning 限定放鬆時段，其他人負責早餐，不是永久退出。

reply.promptEn: What did Martha want the following morning?
reply.promptZh: 瑪莎翌晨想怎樣過？

options.en: She wanted to sit back and take it easy after hosting everyone.
options.zh: 招呼大家後，她想放鬆一下。

options.en: She hoped for a relaxed morning without organising another full set of activities.
options.zh: 她想輕鬆過早晨，不再安排另一整套活動。

options.en: She was happy for the others to handle breakfast and their own plans.
options.zh: 她樂意讓其他人處理早餐及各自計劃。

options.en: She wanted a period with less effort, not a permanent end to family gatherings.
options.zh: 她想暫時少費力，而非永久結束家庭聚會。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 旅行人物早上已走完長路，下午選坐海邊看景，不再參加額外導賞；晚飯仍會與朋友見面。哪句貼切？

options.en: She wants to sit back and take it easy for the afternoon.
options.zh: 她下午想放鬆一下。

options.en: She has decided that she no longer wants to see the friends on the trip.
options.zh: 她已決定旅程中不想再見朋友。

options.en: She plans another demanding walk instead of staying by the sea.
options.zh: 她計劃再走一段辛苦路，而非留海邊。

scene.explanationZh: 下午較輕鬆的選擇，不否定晚飯見面或變成新長路。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 sit back and take it easy 得出？

options.en: 當時想放鬆，少作費力活動。
人物已永久放棄所有責任及興趣。
需看上下文才知是短暫休息還是較長期生活選擇。

contrast.explanationZh: 放鬆的時段與永久放棄是不同範圍。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「她不再帶下午導賞，是否連晚飯也不想見我們？」但她已說晚上會來。哪句回應較準確？

options.en: She wants to sit back and take it easy this afternoon; that does not cancel the dinner she agreed to.
options.zh: 她下午想放鬆一下，沒有取消已答應的晚飯。

options.en: Take the quiet afternoon as a cancellation of the dinner she has already accepted.
options.zh: 把她下午想安靜過，當成取消已答應的晚飯。

options.en: Fill her free afternoon with another guided tour before asking whether she wants it.
options.zh: 未問她是否想參加，就用另一場導賞填滿下午空檔。

dialogue.explanationZh: 已答應晚飯與下午放鬆可並存；應尊重這段時間的選擇，不當作取消晚飯或擅自加導賞。

speaking.en: I would like to sit back and take it easy for a while, then join you for dinner later.
speaking.zh: 我想放鬆一會，之後再與你吃晚飯。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再保留暫時放鬆的時間範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友邀你到家中過周末，擔心要安排完整節目才算招待周到。你想回覆自己更希望輕鬆聊天、一起做簡單午餐，不需要他帶你趕景點。用一至兩句英文減輕他的招待壓力。

examples.en: I would be happy to sit back and take it easy with you, sharing a simple lunch and a conversation. Please do not feel you need to plan a tour of every local sight.
examples.zh: 我很樂意與你輕鬆過，吃簡單午餐並談天。請別覺得需要安排遊遍每個本地景點。

examples.en: We can sit back and take it easy this weekend rather than rush through a full programme. Spending time together matters more to me than the number of places we visit.
examples.zh: 這周末我們可放鬆一下，而非趕完整節目。對我而言，一起相處比去了多少地方更重要。

writing.selfCheckZh: 友善表達輕鬆相處的偏好，肯定陪伴，不把放鬆寫成拒絕朋友或強迫對方同樣安排。

takeaways.en: They sat back and took it easy after finishing the preparations for the visitors.
takeaways.zh: 完成訪客準備後，他們放鬆一下。

takeaways.en: He did not want to sit back and take it easy all year; he still enjoyed choosing new projects.
takeaways.zh: 他不想整年都輕鬆過；他仍享受選擇新計劃。
